import Foundation

enum FileStorageError: Error, Sendable {
    case failedToCreateDirectory(String)
    case failedToRead(String)
    case failedToWrite(String)
    case invalidPayload
}

struct AtomicFileWriter: Sendable {
    typealias PreSwapHook = (URL) throws -> Void

    private let onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook?

    init(onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook? = nil) {
        self.onBeforeSwap = onBeforeSwap
    }

    func write<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to url: URL) throws {
        let containerURL = url.deletingLastPathComponent()

        do {
            try createDirectoryIfNeeded(at: containerURL)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory("could not create parent directory for \(url.path): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }

        let data = try encode(value)
        let tempURL = containerURL.appendingPathComponent(".\(url.lastPathComponent).tmp-\(UUID().uuidString)")

        do {
            try data.write(to: tempURL, options: .atomic)
            try onBeforeSwap?(tempURL)
            // replaceItemAt consumes/moves the item at tempURL into place —
            // there is nothing left at tempURL to remove afterward. Removing
            // it here (as a prior version did) throws "no such file" on
            // every successful save and gets caught below as a false write
            // failure, which is exactly the "app lies about the player's
            // own data" bug class this project exists to avoid.
            try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(url, withItemAt: tempURL)
        } catch {
            _ = try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)
            if let error = error as? FileStorageError {
                throw error
            }
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("atomic write failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from url: URL) throws -> T {
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
            throw FileStorageError.invalidPayload
        }

        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(type, from: data)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToRead("decode failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func createDirectoryIfNeeded(at url: URL) throws {
        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else { return }
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    }

    private func encode<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> Data {
        do {
            return try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("encoding failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }
}

final class FileStorage: Sendable {
    private let rootURL: URL

    init(rootURL: URL) {
        self.rootURL = rootURL
    }

    private func resolvedURL(for fileURL: URL) -> URL {
        fileURL.path.hasPrefix("/") ? fileURL : rootURL.appendingPathComponent(fileURL.lastPathComponent)
    }

    /// Whether a file genuinely exists at `fileURL` yet. Callers use this to
    /// distinguish "nothing has ever been saved here" (the legitimate,
    /// honest starting state on a fresh install — not a failure) from "a
    /// file exists but couldn't be read/decoded" (a real error `read`
    /// should surface). Without this distinction every first launch would
    /// report the identical error as genuine corruption, since
    /// `AtomicFileWriter.read` throws the same `.invalidPayload` for both.
    func fileExists(at fileURL: URL) -> Bool {
        FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: resolvedURL(for: fileURL).path)
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from fileURL: URL) async throws -> T {
        try AtomicFileWriter().read(type, from: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }

    func writeAtomically<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to fileURL: URL) async throws {
        try AtomicFileWriter().write(value, to: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }
}

        .frame(width: cardWidth, height: cardHeight)
    }

    // MARK: - Tableau

    private var tableauRow: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: Theme.Spacing.pileGap) {
            ForEach(engine.state.tableau.indices, id: \.self) { column in
                tableauColumn(column)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    private func tableauColumn(_ column: Int) -> some View {
        let cards = engine.state.tableau[column]
        let totalHeight = cardHeight + overlapStep * CGFloat(max(cards.count - 1, 0))

        return ZStack(alignment: .top) {
            if cards.isEmpty {
                emptySlot(label: "Tableau column \(column + 1), empty", systemHint: nil)
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onTapGesture { onTap(.tableau(column), nil) }
                    .accessibilityIdentifier(AccessibilityID.tableauTopCard(column: column))
            } else {
                ForEach(Array(cards.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, card in
                    cardView(card, pile: .tableau(column), index: index)
                        .offset(y: CGFloat(index) * overlapStep)
                        .zIndex(Double(index))
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(width: cardWidth, height: max(totalHeight, cardHeight), alignment: .top)
    }

    // MARK: - Shared card wrapper

    @ViewBuilder
    private func cardView(_ card: Card, pile: PileID, index: Int) -> some View {
        CardView(card: card, state: visualState(for: pile, index: index))
            .frame(width: cardWidth, height: cardHeight)
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
            .onTapGesture { onTap(pile, index) }
            .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityLabel(for: card, pile: pile))
            .accessibilityIdentifier(topCardIdentifier(pile: pile, index: index))
    }

    private func visualState(for pile: PileID, index: Int) -> CardVisualState {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, let destinations) = engine.interaction {
            if source == pile && index >= cardIndex {
                return .selected
            }
            if destinations.contains(pile) && isTopIndex(pile: pile, index: index) {
                return .legalDestination
            }
        }
        return .normal
    }

    private func isTopIndex(pile: PileID, index: Int) -> Bool {
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return index == engine.state.stock.count - 1
        case .waste: return index == engine.state.waste.count - 1
        case .foundation(let suit): return index == (engine.state.foundations[suit]?.count ?? 0) - 1
        case .tableau(let column): return index == engine.state.tableau[column].count - 1
        }
    }

    /// Only the card that's the actual top card of a legal-destination
    /// column gets the destination's declared identifier — cards below it
    /// keep their own per-card identity, matching `flows.json`'s
    /// "tableau.column0.topCard" naming (the *interactive* target is always
    /// the top card, since Klondike only ever accepts a placement there).
    private func topCardIdentifier(pile: PileID, index: Int) -> String {
        guard isTopIndex(pile: pile, index: index) else {
            return "game.\(pileSlug(pile)).card\(index)"
        }
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return AccessibilityID.Game.stockPile
        case .waste: return "game.wastePile.topCard"
        case .foundation(let suit): return AccessibilityID.foundation(suit)
        case .tableau(let column): return AccessibilityID.tableauTopCard(column: column)
        }
    }

    private func pileSlug(_ pile: PileID) -> String {
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return "stockPile"
        case .waste: return "wastePile"
        case .foundation(let suit): return "foundation.\(suit.rawValue)"
        case .tableau(let column): return "tableau.column\(column)"
        }
    }

    /// Base rank/suit/face-state label plus the pile/position context
    /// `CardView` deliberately omits ([REDACTED:high_entropy]'s own
    /// example: "Seven of Hearts, tableau column 3").
    private func accessibilityLabel(for card: Card, pile: PileID) -> String {
        guard card.isFaceUp else { return "Face-down card, \(pileDescription(pile))" }
        return "\(card.rank.displayName) of \(suitName(card.suit)), \(pileDescription(pile))"
    }

    private func pileDescription(_ pile: PileID) -> String {
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return "stock"
        case .waste: return "waste"
        case .foundation(let suit): return "foundation, \(suitName(suit))"
        case .tableau(let column): return "tableau column \(column + 1)"
        }
    }

    private func suitName(_ suit: Suit) -> String {
        switch suit {
        case .clubs: return "Clubs"
        case .diamonds: return "Diamonds"
        case .hearts: return "Hearts"
        case .spades: return "Spades"
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func emptySlot(label: String, systemHint: String?) -> some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Theme.Radius.pile, style: .continuous)
            .strokeBorder(Theme.Card.frontEdge.opacity(0.35), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.5, dash: [4, 4]))
            .overlay {
                if let systemHint {
                    Image(systemName: systemHint)
                        .foregroundStyle(Theme.Card.frontEdge.opacity(0.6))
                }
            }
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

final class DrawOneStuckDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorNeverFalsePositiveAfterLegalMoveSequences() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()
        var state = Self.dealtState(seed: 1)
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: 9_973)
        var legalStateCount = 0
        var seed: UInt64 = 1
        var loops = 0

        while legalStateCount < 10_000 && loops < 150_000 {
            loops += 1

            let actions = Self.legalActions(for: state)
            if actions.isEmpty {
                seed += 1
                state = Self.dealtState(seed: seed)
                continue
            }

            XCTAssertFalse(detector.isStuck(state), "Detected stuck in state with legal moves.")

            let action = actions.randomElement(using: &rng)!
            Self.apply(action, to: &state)

            legalStateCount += 1
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(legalStateCount, 10_000)
    }

    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorHasNoStockRecycleSimulationShortcut() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()

        let state = GameState(
            stock: [],
            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            foundations: [
                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .diamonds: [Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
                .spades: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            ],
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(detector.isStuck(state))
    }

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

    private static func canMoveAsWasteTop(_ card: Card, in state: GameState) -> Bool {
        for suit in Suit.allCases {

            if MoveValidator.isLegal(cards: [card], source: .waste, destination: .tableau(tableauIndex), state: state) {
                return true
            }
        }

    }

private struct SeededRandomNumberGenerator: RandomNumberGenerator {

        state = state &* 6_364_136_223_846_793_005 &+ 1
        return state
    }
}

import XCTest

@testable import SolitaireAtelier

final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
        var state = validStateTemplate()
        guard let duplicateCard = state.waste.last else {
            return XCTFail("Expected at least one waste card in the template.")
        }
        // Discard some other, unrelated card entirely so the total count
        // stays at 52 while introducing a genuine same-id duplicate — the
        // count check alone would otherwise mask the duplicate-detection
        // path being exercised.
        _ = state.stock.removeLast()
        state.stock.append(duplicateCard)

        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
    }

    func testRejectsIncompleteDeck() {
        // Note: with Card.id derived purely from suit+rank over a fixed
        // 52-value domain, "52 unique ids" and "all 52 cards present" are
        // logically equivalent — a state can never have exactly 52 unique
        // ids while missing a rank, since the only way to reach 52 again
        // after removing one card is to duplicate another, which the
        // duplicate check (run before the per-suit completeness check)
        // always catches first. So the reachable way to test the
        // completeness requirement is a genuinely short deck, not a
        // same-count substitution.
        var state = validStateTemplate()
        remove(Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ace), from: &state)

        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
            return XCTFail("Expected a 51-card deck to be invalid.")
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("mismatch"))
    }

    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
        var state = validStateTemplate()
        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
        remove(badTop, from: &state)
        remove(badNext, from: &state)
        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]

        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
    }

    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
        var state = validStateTemplate()
        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
        remove(illegalTop, from: &state)
        remove(illegalBase, from: &state)
        state.foundations[.spades] = [illegalBase, illegalTop]

        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
    }

    /// Removes every card matching `target`'s suit+rank from wherever it
    /// currently lives (stock/waste/any foundation/any tableau column), so
    /// callers can relocate a card into a deliberately-illegal position
    /// without silently duplicating it (a card only ever needs removing
    /// from whichever single pile actually holds it, but the tests below
    /// shouldn't have to know or assume which one that is).
    private func remove(_ target: Card, from state: inout GameState) {
        let matches: (Card) -> Bool = { $0.suit == target.suit && $0.rank == target.rank }
        state.stock.removeAll(where: matches)
        state.waste.removeAll(where: matches)
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            state.foundations[suit]?.removeAll(where: matches)
        }
        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            state.tableau[index].removeAll(where: matches)

import SwiftUI

/// Settings-only draw-mode control (DEC-design_handoff-003) — structurally
/// distinct from `StatsModeFilter`, which is Stats-only, pure local view
/// state, zero side effects. This one mutates real state, so it never writes
/// to `mode` directly: every tap reports intent via `onRequestChange`, and
/// the parent (backed by `GameEngine`/`SettingsStore` once they exist)
/// decides whether that requires routing through `DrawModeConfirmSheet`
/// (`hasActiveGame == true`, DEC-app_features-005) or can apply immediately
/// (no game in progress to discard). This view never shows a confirmation
/// dialog itself — it only ever asks.
public struct DrawModeSetting: View {
    @Binding public var mode: DrawMode
    public let hasActiveGame: Bool
    public let onRequestChange: (DrawMode) -> Void

    public init(mode: Binding<DrawMode>, hasActiveGame: Bool, onRequestChange: @escaping (DrawMode) -> Void) {
        self._mode = mode
        self.hasActiveGame = hasActiveGame
        self.onRequestChange = onRequestChange
    }

    public var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Theme.Spacing.xs) {
            Text("Draw Mode")
                .font(Theme.Fonts.headline)

            Picker("Draw Mode", selection: requestBinding) {
                Text("Draw One")
                    .tag(DrawMode.drawOne)
                    .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting.drawOneOption")
                Text("Draw Three")
                    .tag(DrawMode.drawThree)
                    .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting.drawThreeOption")
            }
            .pickerStyle(.segmented)
            .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting")

            Text(hasActiveGame
                 ? "Changing this discards your current game and deals a fresh one."
                 : "Changing this takes effect on your next new game.")
                .font(Theme.Fonts.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    /// Displays the current `mode` but never writes to it — a change
    /// attempt only ever calls `onRequestChange`, since only the parent
    /// knows whether that needs to go through a confirmation sheet first.
    private var requestBinding: Binding<DrawMode> {
        Binding(
            get: { mode },
            set: { newValue in
                guard newValue != mode else { return }
                onRequestChange(newValue)
            }
        )
    }
}

import Foundation
import Observation

@MainActor
@Observable
public final class GameEngine {
    public private(set) var state: GameState
    public private(set) var interaction: InteractionState

    private let saveStore: GameSaveStore
    private let statsStore: StatsLogStore
    private let settingsStore: SettingsStore
    private let haptics: HapticsService
    private let integrityService: RestoreIntegrityService

    private var undoStack: UndoStack
    private var timerTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var bootstrapCompleted = false
    private var sessionId: UUID?
    private var sessionHasStartedEvent = false
    private var sessionUndoCount: Int
    private var settings: SettingsFile
    private var timerEnabled: Bool

    public init(
        saveStore: GameSaveStore,
        statsStore: StatsLogStore,
        settingsStore: SettingsStore,
        haptics: HapticsService,
        integrity: RestoreIntegrityService = RestoreIntegrityService()
    ) {
        self.saveStore = saveStore
        self.statsStore = statsStore
        self.settingsStore = settingsStore
        self.haptics = haptics
        self.integrityService = integrity

        let freshState = GameState(drawMode: .drawOne, terminalState: .active)
        self.state = freshState
        self.interaction = .idle
        self.undoStack = UndoStack()
        self.sessionUndoCount = 0
        self.settings = SettingsFile()
        self.timerEnabled = true
    }

    public func bootstrap() async {
        guard "'!bootstrapCompleted else { return }
        bootstrapCompleted = true

        async let restoredGame = saveStore.load()
        async let restoredStats = statsStore.load()
        async let restoredSettings = settingsStore.load()

        _ = await restoredStats
        let loadedSettings: SettingsFile
        switch await restoredSettings {
        case .restored(let file):
            loadedSettings = file
        case .fallbackDefault(let file, _):
            loadedSettings = file
        case .dataLoss:
            loadedSettings = SettingsFile.default
        }

        settings = loadedSettings
        timerEnabled = loadedSettings.timerEnabled

        switch await restoredGame {
        case .restored(let file):
            state = file.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: file.undoStack)

            if !state.stock.isEmpty || !state.waste.isEmpty || state.foundations.values.contains(where: { !$0.isEmpty }) || state.tableau.contains(where: { !$0.isEmpty }) {
                interaction = .idle
                if state.isTimerRunning {
                    startTimer()
                }
                return
            }
            await startFreshGameIfNeeded(loadDefaultFor: loadedSettings.drawMode)

        case .fallbackDefault(let file, _):
            // Fresh install / missing game file should render an immediate first deal.
            state = file.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: file.undoStack)
            interaction = .idle
            await startFreshGameIfNeeded(loadDefaultFor: loadedSettings.drawMode)

        case .dataLoss:
            // Corrupt saved game: surface to coordinator via reason and start cleanly.
            state = GameState(drawMode: loadedSettings.drawMode)
            undoStack = UndoStack()
            interaction = .idle
            await startFreshGameIfNeeded(loadDefaultFor: loadedSettings.drawMode)
        }
    }

    public func newGame(drawMode: DrawMode, requiresConfirmation: Bool, rng: any RandomNumberGenerator = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()) {
        guard !requiresConfirmation else { return }
        finalizeActiveSession(won: false)

        startGameState(drawMode: drawMode, rng: rng)
        persistAll()
    }

    public func selectCard(pile: PileID, index: Int) {
        guard state.terminalState == .active else {
            interaction = .idle
            return
        }

        switch pile {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            interaction = .idle
            return

        case .waste:
            guard !state.waste.isEmpty else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }
            let available = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: pile, sourceIndex: nil)
            if available.isEmpty {
                interaction = .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: 0, legalDestinations: [])
            } else {
                interaction = interaction == .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: 0, legalDestinations: available)
                    ? .idle
                    : .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: 0, legalDestinations: available)
            }

        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0 && index < state.tableau.count else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }
            guard index < state.tableau[index].count else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }
            guard state.tableau[index][index].isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let available = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: pile, sourceIndex: index)
            interaction = interaction == .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: available)
                ? .idle
                : .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: available)
        }
    }

    public func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome {
        guard state.terminalState == .active else { return .blocked(reason: "Game is not active") }
        guard case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _) = interaction else {
            return .blocked(reason: "No source selected")
        }

        if !isConfirmedActionAllowed() {
            return .blocked(reason: "No source selected")
        }

        startTimerIfNeededForAction()
        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(
            in: state,
            source: source,
            sourceIndex: cardIndex,
            destination: destination
        )

        switch outcome {
        case .executed(let move):
            commitMoveSnapshotIfNeeded()
            apply(move)
            sessionUndoCount += 1
            interaction = .resolvingMove(move)
            haptics.moveAccepted()
            applyPostActionTerminalChecks()
            persistAll()
            interaction = .idle

            Task {
                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 120_000_000)
                if case .resolvingMove = self.interaction {
                    self.interaction = .idle
                }
            }

            return outcome

        case .ambiguous:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            return outcome

        case .blocked:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()
            return outcome
        }
    }

    public func drawFromStock() {
        guard state.terminalState == .active else { return }

        let hadNoCards = state.stock.isEmpty

        if state.stock.isEmpty {
            if state.waste.isEmpty {
                return
            }
            startTimerIfNeededForAction()
            let recycled = state.waste
                .reversed()
                .map { card -> Card in
                    var mutable = card
                    mutable.isFaceUp = false
                    return mutable
                }
            state.stock = recycled
            state.waste.removeAll()
            interaction = .idle
            haptics.stockDraw()
            persistAll()
            return
        }

        let drawCount = state.drawMode == .drawOne ? 1 : 3
        var drawn: [Card] = []
        for _ in 0..<drawCount {
            guard let raw = state.stock.popLast() else { break }
            var card = raw
            card.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(card)
            drawn.append(card)
        }

        guard !drawn.isEmpty else { return }
        startTimerIfNeededForAction()
        interaction = .idle
        commitMoveSnapshotIfNeeded()
        applyPostActionTerminalChecks()
        haptics.stockDraw()
        persistAll()

        if hadNoCards && drawCount > 0 {
            haptics.stockDraw()
        }

        if !drawn.isEmpty {
            sessionUndoCount += drawn.count
        }
    }

    public func undo() -> Bool {
        guard let snapshot = undoStack.pop() else { return false }

        stopTimerIfNeeded(freeze: true)
        state = snapshot.state
        interaction = .idle
        if state.isTimerRunning {
            startTimer()
        }
        persistAll()
        sessionUndoCount += 1
        haptics.undo()
        return true
    }

    public func setDrawMode(_ mode: DrawMode) {
        guard mode != state.drawMode else { return }

        state.drawMode = mode
        settings.drawMode = mode
        Task {
            await self.settingsStore.save(SettingsFile(
                drawMode: mode,
                cardBack: self.settings.cardBack,
                timerEnabled: self.settings.timerEnabled
            ))
        }

        if case .active = state.terminalState {
            interaction = .idle
        }

        persistAll()
    }

    public func flushPersistence() async {
        await saveStore.save(GameSaveFile(state: state, undoStack: undoStack.entries))
        await statsStore.flush()
        await settingsStore.flush()
        await saveStore.flush()
    }

    private func startFreshGameIfNeeded(loadDefaultFor drawMode: DrawMode) async {
        await MainActor.run {
            startGameState(drawMode: drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())
            persistAll()
        }
    }

    private func startGameState(drawMode: DrawMode, rng: any RandomNumberGenerator) {
        finalizeActiveSession(won: false)

        let nextState = GameState(
            stock: []
                , waste: []
                , foundations: Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
                , tableau: Self.dealtTableau(from: rng)
                , drawMode: drawMode
                , elapsedSeconds: 0
                , isTimerRunning: false
                , startedAt: nil
                , terminalState: .active
        )

        state = nextState
        interaction = .dealing
        sessionId = UUID()
        sessionHasStartedEvent = true
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        undoStack = UndoStack()
        recordSessionStarted()

        Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 150_000_000)
            if case .dealing = self.interaction {
                self.interaction = .idle
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtTableau(from rng: any RandomNumberGenerator) -> [[Card]] {
        var cards = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: 7)

        var cursor = 0
        for column in 0..<7 {
            for _ in 0...column {
                tableau[column].append(cards[cursor])
                cursor += 1
            }
        }

        for column in 0..<7 {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            var columnCards = tableau[column]
            columnCards[columnCards.count - 1].isFaceUp = true
            tableau[column] = columnCards
        }

        let stock = Array(cards.dropFirst(cursor))
        return stock.isEmpty ? Array(repeating: [], count: 7) : tableau
    }

    private static func finalStock(from cards: [Card], startIndex: Int) -> [Card] {
        guard startIndex <= cards.count else { return [] }
        return Array(cards[startIndex...])
    }

    private func isConfirmedActionAllowed() -> Bool {
        guard case .sourceSelected = interaction else {
            return false
        }
        return true
    }

    private func apply(_ move: Move) {
        applySourceRemoval(from: move)
        applyDestinationAppend(move)
        finalizeAutoFlip(for: move.source)
        evaluateWinOrStuck()
        stopTimerIfNeededForTerminal()
    }

    private func applySourceRemoval(from move: Move) {
        switch move.source {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            break
        case .waste:
            _ = state.waste.popLast()
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return }
            let pile = state.tableau[index]
            guard let first = move.cards.first,
                  let start = pile.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == first.id }) else {
                return
            }

            state.tableau[index].removeSubrange(start..<(start + move.cards.count))
        }

import Foundation

public enum MoveValidator {
    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        switch destinations.count {
        case 0:
            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
        case 1:
            return .executed(Move(
                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
                source: source,
                destination: destinations[0]
            ))
        default:
            return .ambiguous(
                source: source,
                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
                destinations: destinations
            )
        }
    }

    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let cards else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [PileID] {
        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let movingCards else { return [] }

        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
        var destinations: [PileID] = []

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
                destinations.append(foundation)
            }
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
            if tableau == source { continue }

            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
                destinations.append(tableau)
            }
        }

        return destinations
    }

    public static func movingCards(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [Card]? {
        switch source {
        case .stock:
            return nil
        case .waste:
            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
            return [top]
        case .foundation:
            return nil
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard let sourceIndex else {
                return nil
            }
            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
        }
    }

    public static func isLegal(
        cards: [Card],
        source: PileID,
        destination: PileID,
        state: GameState
    ) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
        let head = cards[0]

        switch destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            return false
        case .foundation(let suit):
            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            if destination == source { return false }
            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
        }
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        guard let destinationTop else {
            return card.rank == .king
        }
        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
        if let top = destination.last {
            return top.isFaceUp &&
            top.suit == card.suit &&
            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
        }
        return card.rank == .ace
    }

    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> String {
        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
            return "No legal move source selected."
        }
        return "No legal destination for selected card."
    }

    private static func moveBlockedReason(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> String {
        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
            return "Invalid source for move."
        }
        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
            return "No cards selected."
        }
        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
            return "Destination is not legal."
        }
        return "Move blocked."
    }

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

        cachedModel = model

/// Draw-3 stuck detection.
///
/// Conservative approximation for draw-3 mode: unlike draw-1's exact static pass,
/// stock cards are treated as a future, hypothetical waste stream. Any remaining stock
/// means a future draw can expose additional candidates, so we never report a hard stuck
/// while stock exists (no false-positive stuck). This deliberately favors avoiding false
/// positives over perfect draw-cycle accuracy; exact reachability is out of scope for this
/// build slice.
public struct DrawThreeStuckDetector: StuckDetector {
    public init() {}

    public func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            return false

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let wasteTopMoves = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if !wasteTopMoves.isEmpty {
                return false
            }
        }

        return !StateMoveScanner.hasLegalMove(state)
    }

public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }

import Foundation

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onTapGesture { onTap(.tableau(column), nil) }

            } else {

        .frame(width: cardWidth, height: max(totalHeight, cardHeight), alignment: .top)

        case .waste: return "game.wastePile.topCard"

/// Settings-only draw-mode control (DEC-design_handoff-003) — structurally
/// distinct from `StatsModeFilter`, which is Stats-only, pure local view
/// state, zero side effects. This one mutates real state, so it never writes
/// to `mode` directly: every tap reports intent via `onRequestChange`, and
/// the parent (backed by `GameEngine`/`SettingsStore` once they exist)
/// decides whether that requires routing through `DrawModeConfirmSheet`
/// (`hasActiveGame == true`, DEC-app_features-005) or can apply immediately
/// (no game in progress to discard). This view never shows a confirmation
/// dialog itself — it only ever asks.
public struct DrawModeSetting: View {
    @Binding public var mode: DrawMode
    public let hasActiveGame: Bool
    public let onRequestChange: (DrawMode) -> Void

    public init(mode: Binding<DrawMode>, hasActiveGame: Bool, onRequestChange: @escaping (DrawMode) -> Void) {
        self._mode = mode
        self.hasActiveGame = hasActiveGame
        self.onRequestChange = onRequestChange
    }

    public var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Theme.Spacing.xs) {
            Text("Draw Mode")
                .font(Theme.Fonts.headline)

            Picker("Draw Mode", selection: requestBinding) {
                Text("Draw One")
                    .tag(DrawMode.drawOne)
                    .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting.drawOneOption")
                Text("Draw Three")
                    .tag(DrawMode.drawThree)
                    .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting.drawThreeOption")
            }
            .pickerStyle(.segmented)
            .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting")

            Text(hasActiveGame

                .font(Theme.Fonts.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    /// Displays the current `mode` but never writes to it — a change
    /// attempt only ever calls `onRequestChange`, since only the parent

    private var requestBinding: Binding<DrawMode> {

import XCTest
@testable import SolitaireAtelier

actor TrackedStore<StoredModel>: PersistenceStore where StoredModel: Codable & Sendable {
    typealias Model = StoredModel

    private let outcome: RestoreOutcome<Model>
    private let artificialDelayNanoseconds: UInt64
    private var loadInvocations: Int = 0

    init(outcome: RestoreOutcome<Model>, artificialDelay: TimeInterval = 0.0) {
        self.outcome = outcome
        self.artificialDelayNanoseconds = UInt64(artificialDelay * 1_000_000_000)
    }

    func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<Model> {
        loadInvocations += 1
        if artificialDelayNanoseconds > 0 {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: artificialDelayNanoseconds)
        }
        return outcome
    }

    func save(_ model: Model) async {}

    func loadInvocationCount() async -> Int {
        loadInvocations
    }
}

final class DrawOneStuckDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorNeverFalsePositiveAfterLegalMoveSequences() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()
        var state = Self.dealtState(seed: 1)
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: 9_973)
        var legalStateCount = 0
        var seed: UInt64 = 1
        var loops = 0

        while legalStateCount < 10_000 && loops < 150_000 {
            loops += 1

            let actions = Self.legalActions(for: state)
            if actions.isEmpty {
                seed += 1
                state = Self.dealtState(seed: seed)
                continue
            }

            XCTAssertFalse(detector.isStuck(state), "Detected stuck in state with legal moves.")

            let action = actions.randomElement(using: &rng)!
            Self.apply(action, to: &state)

            legalStateCount += 1
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(legalStateCount, 10_000)
    }

    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorHasNoStockRecycleSimulationShortcut() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()

        let state = GameState(
            stock: [],
            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            foundations: [
                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .diamonds: [Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
                .spades: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            ],
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(detector.isStuck(state))
    }

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

    func testDrawThreeStuckDetectorDoesNotFalseStuckWhenLegalMoveIsBuriedInStockCycle() {
        let detector = DrawThreeStuckDetector()

        // Specific buried-position fixture:
        // Stock top order (last is immediate next draw): 3, 4, 5, A♥, 8♣, 9♠, 10♦.
        // The first three visible draw-3 cards are not legal in this state; only the 4th card
        // in the cycle (A♥) would become legal on a future draw.
        let state = GameState(
            stock: [
                Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .spades, rank: .nine, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .eight, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .four, isFaceUp: true),
                Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
            ],
            waste: [],
            foundations: Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) }),
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawThree
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil).isEmpty)
        XCTAssertFalse(StateMoveScanner.hasLegalMove(state))
        XCTAssertTrue(state.waste.isEmpty)

        for candidateIndex in 0..<3 {
            XCTAssertFalse(
                DrawThreeStuckDetectorTests.canMoveAsWasteTop(
                    state.stock[state.stock.count - 1 - candidateIndex],
                    in: state
                ),
                "Top draw-3 candidates are intentionally non-legal in this fixture"
            )
        }

        let buriedAceLegal = DrawThreeStuckDetectorTests.canMoveAsWasteTop(
            state.stock[state.stock.count - 4],
            in: state
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(buriedAceLegal, "The buried legal move must remain detectable in this fixture.")

        XCTAssertFalse(
            detector.isStuck(state),
            "Draw-3 approximation must not falsely report stuck when a buried stock card is legally placeable."
        )
    }

    private static func canMoveAsWasteTop(_ card: Card, in state: GameState) -> Bool {
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            if MoveValidator.isLegal(cards: [card], source: .waste, destination: .foundation(suit), state: state) {
                return true
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in state.tableau.indices {
            if MoveValidator.isLegal(cards: [card], source: .waste, destination: .tableau(tableauIndex), state: state) {
                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }
}

public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
    private enum Constants {
        static let maxDepth = 200
    }

    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]

    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
        self.entries = entries
    }

    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
        entries.append(snapshot)
        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
        }
    }

    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
        return entries.popLast()
    }

    public var isEmpty: Bool {

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Canonical finite-state interaction contract for the game screen.
/// Game UI must derive all selection/highlight/ambiguity behavior from
/// this type, not from parallel @State booleans.
public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

    public func clearSelection() -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum MoveValidation {
    // Centralized rule entry points kept for backward compatibility with preexisting callers.
    // New logic lives in Domain/Rules/MoveValidator.

    public static func colorFlips(_ lhs: Card, _ rhs: Card) -> Bool {
        lhs.suit.color != rhs.suit.color
    }

    public static func canPlace(_ moving: Card, on tableauTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        MoveValidator.canPlaceOnTableau(card: moving, destinationTop: tableauTop)
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(_ moving: Card, foundation: [Card]) -> Bool {
        MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: moving, destination: foundation)
    }

    public static func topCard(of cards: [Card]?) -> Card? {
        cards?.last
    }

    public static func topCard(of state: GameState, in pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    public static func tableauRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau index: Int,
        cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: cardIndex)
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> [PileID] {
        MoveValidator.legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
    }

    public static func isLegalFoundationSetup(_ foundation: [Card], suit: Suit) -> Bool {
        guard let first = foundation.first else { return true }
        guard first.suit == suit else { return false }
        guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: first, destination: []) else {
            return false
        }

        for i in 1..<foundation.count {
            let previous = foundation[i - 1]
            let card = foundation[i]
            guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: card, destination: [previous]) else { return false }
        }
        return true
    }

    public static func isAlternatingFaceUpRun(_ run: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard run.count > 1 else { return true }
        guard run.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) else { return false }

        for index in 0..<(run.count - 1) {
            let moving = run[index]
            let top = run[index + 1]
            if !MoveValidator.canPlaceOnTableau(card: top, destinationTop: moving) { return false }
        }
        return true
    }
}

final class DrawOneStuckDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorNeverFalsePositiveAfterLegalMoveSequences() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()
        var state = Self.dealtState(seed: 1)
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: 9_973)
        var legalStateCount = 0
        var seed: UInt64 = 1
        var loops = 0

        while legalStateCount < 10_000 && loops < 150_000 {
            loops += 1

            let actions = Self.legalActions(for: state)
            if actions.isEmpty {
                seed += 1
                state = Self.dealtState(seed: seed)
                continue
            }

            XCTAssertFalse(detector.isStuck(state), "Detected stuck in state with legal moves.")

            let action = actions.randomElement(using: &rng)!
            Self.apply(action, to: &state)

            legalStateCount += 1
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(legalStateCount, 10_000)
    }

    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorHasNoStockRecycleSimulationShortcut() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()

        let state = GameState(
            stock: [],
            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            foundations: [
                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .diamonds: [Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
                .spades: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            ],
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(detector.isStuck(state))
    }

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

        for suit in Suit.allCases {

            }

            if MoveValidator.isLegal(cards: [card], source: .waste, destination: .tableau(tableauIndex), state: state) {
                return true
            }
        }

    }

    /// from whichever single pile actually holds it, but the tests below
    /// shouldn't have to know or assume which one that is).
    private func remove(_ target: Card, from state: inout GameState) {
        let matches: (Card) -> Bool = { $0.suit == target.suit && $0.rank == target.rank }
        state.stock.removeAll(where: matches)
        state.waste.removeAll(where: matches)
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            state.foundations[suit]?.removeAll(where: matches)
        }
        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            state.tableau[index].removeAll(where: matches)
        }
    }

            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }

            state.startedAt = nil
        }

        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
    }

        return detector.isStuck(state)

            if (state.foundations[suit] ?? []).count != 13 {

        return true
    }

    private func drawFromStockPile() {
        let drawCount = state.drawMode == .drawOne ? 1 : 3

        var drawn: [Card] = []
        for _ in 0..<drawCount {
            guard let next = state.stock.popLast() else { break }
            var open = next
            open.isFaceUp = true
            drawn.append(open)

        guard !drawn.isEmpty else { return }
        state.waste.append(contentsOf: drawn)
    }

            recycled.append(facedDown)
