        state.waste.removeAll(keepingCapacity: false)
        state.stock = recycled
    }

        switch move.source {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            break

        case .waste:
            guard let removed = state.waste.popLast(), removed == move.cards.first else {
                return
            }

        case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
            guard let first = move.cards.first else { return }
            guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == first.id }) else { return }
            let end = start + move.cards.count
            guard start < state.tableau[sourceIndex].count, end <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }

            guard run == move.cards else { return }

            state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<end)
            if let topIndex = state.tableau[sourceIndex].indices.last {
                if !state.tableau[sourceIndex][topIndex].isFaceUp {
                    state.tableau[sourceIndex][topIndex].isFaceUp = true
                }
            }
        }

        switch move.destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            break

        case .foundation(let suit):
            guard move.cards.count == 1 else { return }
            state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: move.cards)

        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            guard state.tableau.indices.contains(destinationIndex) else { return }
            state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: move.cards)
        }
    }

    private func startTimerIfNeededForAction() {
        guard settings.timerEnabled else { return }
        if state.isTimerRunning { return }

        timerAnchor = Date()
        timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
        state.startedAt = timerAnchor
        state.isTimerRunning = true
        startTimerTask()
    }

    private func startTimerTask() {
        timerTask?.cancel()

        timerTask = Task {
            while true {
                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 250_000_000)
                guard let anchor = timerAnchor else { return }
                await MainActor.run {
                    guard self.state.isTimerRunning else { return }
                    self.state.elapsedSeconds = self.timerAnchorElapsed + Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func stopTimerAndReturnElapsed(enabled: Bool) -> TimeInterval? {
        guard enabled else { return nil }
        guard let anchor = timerAnchor else {
            return state.isTimerRunning ? state.elapsedSeconds : state.elapsedSeconds
        }

        state.elapsedSeconds = timerAnchorElapsed + Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
        state.isTimerRunning = false
        state.startedAt = nil
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil

        return state.elapsedSeconds
    }

    private func freezeTimerClock() {
        guard settings.timerEnabled else {
            timerTask?.cancel()
            timerTask = nil
            timerAnchor = nil
            return
        }

        if let anchor = timerAnchor {
            state.elapsedSeconds = timerAnchorElapsed + Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
            timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
        }

        state.isTimerRunning = false
        state.startedAt = nil
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
    }

    private func persistCurrentSnapshot() {
        Task {
            await saveStore.save(
                GameSaveFile(
                    state: state,
                    undoStack: undoStack.entries
                )
            )
            persistSettings()
        }
    }

    private func persistSettings() {
        Task {
            await settingsStore.save(settings)
        }
    }

    private func applySettingsRestore(_ outcome: RestoreOutcome<SettingsFile>) -> SettingsFile {
        switch outcome {
        case .restored(let file):
            return file
        case .fallbackDefault(let file, _), .dataLoss(let file):
            return file
        }
    }
}

private extension ValidationResult {
    var asReason: String {
        switch self {
        case .valid:
            return ""
        case .invalid(let reason):
            return reason
        }
    }
}

public enum MoveValidator {
    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        switch destinations.count {
        case 0:
            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
        case 1:
            return .executed(Move(
                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
                source: source,
                destination: destinations[0]
            ))
        default:
            return .ambiguous(
                source: source,
                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
                destinations: destinations
            )
        }
    }

    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let cards else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [PileID] {
        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let movingCards else { return [] }

        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
        var destinations: [PileID] = []

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
                destinations.append(foundation)
            }
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
            if tableau == source { continue }

            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
                destinations.append(tableau)
            }
        }

        return destinations
    }

    public static func movingCards(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [Card]? {
        switch source {
        case .stock:
            return nil
        case .waste:
            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
            return [top]
        case .foundation:
            return nil
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard let sourceIndex else {
                return nil
            }
            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
        }
    }

    public static func isLegal(
        cards: [Card],
        source: PileID,
        destination: PileID,
        state: GameState
    ) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
        let head = cards[0]

        switch destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            return false
        case .foundation(let suit):
            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            if destination == source { return false }
            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
        }
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        guard let destinationTop else {
            return card.rank == .king
        }
        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
        if let top = destination.last {
            return top.isFaceUp &&
            top.suit == card.suit &&
            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
        }
        return card.rank == .ace
    }

    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> String {
        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
            return "No legal move source selected."
        }
        return "No legal destination for selected card."
    }

    private static func moveBlockedReason(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> String {
        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
            return "Invalid source for move."
        }
        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
            return "No cards selected."
        }
        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
            return "Destination is not legal."
        }
        return "Move blocked."
    }

    }

        guard let first = foundation.first else { return true }
        guard first.suit == suit else { return false }
        guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: first, destination: []) else {
            return false
        }

        for i in 1..<foundation.count {
            let previous = foundation[i - 1]
            let card = foundation[i]
            guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: card, destination: [previous]) else { return false }
        }
        return true
    }

    public static func isAlternatingFaceUpRun(_ run: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard run.count > 1 else { return true }
        guard run.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) else { return false }

        for index in 0..<(run.count - 1) {
            let moving = run[index]
            let top = run[index + 1]
            if !MoveValidator.canPlaceOnTableau(card: top, destinationTop: moving) { return false }

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

public actor SettingsStore: PersistenceStore {
    public typealias Model = SettingsFile

    // Floor per DEC-project_plan-005 / DEC-project_plan-006: 0.35s is the
    // minimum accepted debounce for settings persistence writes.
    public static let debounceFloorSeconds: TimeInterval = 0.35
    public static let debounceFloorNanoseconds: UInt64 = UInt64(debounceFloorSeconds * 1_000_000_000)

    private let fileURL: URL
    private let storage: FileStorage

    private var pendingWrite: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var pendingModel: SettingsFile?
    private var lastPersistedModel: SettingsFile?

    public init(fileURL: URL, storage: FileStorage = FileStorage(rootURL: URL.standardPersistenceDirectory())) {
        self.fileURL = fileURL
        self.storage = storage
    }

    deinit {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
    }

    public func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<SettingsFile> {
        guard storage.fileExists(at: fileURL) else {
            // No settings file has ever been written here — a fresh
            // install's honest starting state, not a failure to restore.
            let fresh = SettingsFile.default
            lastPersistedModel = fresh
            return .restored(fresh)
        }

        do {
            let decoded = try await storage.read(SettingsFile.self, from: fileURL)

            guard decoded.schemaVersion == SettingsFile.currentSchemaVersion else {
                let fallback = SettingsFile.default
                return .fallbackDefault(
                    fallback,
                    reason: .schemaMismatch(found: decoded.schemaVersion, expected: SettingsFile.currentSchemaVersion)
                )
            }

            lastPersistedModel = decoded
            return .restored(decoded)
        } catch {
            return .fallbackDefault(SettingsFile.default, reason: mapLoadError(error))
        }
    }

    public func save(_ model: SettingsFile) async {
        if let pendingModel, pendingModel == model {
            return
        }
        if let lastPersistedModel, lastPersistedModel == model {
            return
        }

        self.pendingModel = model
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.debounceFloorNanoseconds)
            if Task.isCancelled { return }

            await self.flushPendingWrite()
        }
    }

    public func flush() async {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = nil
        await flushPendingWrite()
    }

    private func flushPendingWrite() async {
        guard let model = pendingModel else { return }

        do {
            try await storage.writeAtomically(model, to: fileURL)
            pendingModel = nil
            lastPersistedModel = model
        } catch {
            return
        }
    }

    private func mapLoadError(_ error: Error) -> PersistenceError {
        switch error {
        case FileStorageError.invalidPayload:
            return .decodingFailed(description: "Could not decode settings payload")
        case let FileStorageError.failedToRead(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToWrite(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory(description):
            return .ioFailed(description: description)
        default:
            return .ioFailed(description: error.localizedDescription)
        }

    public func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<StatsLogFile> {
        guard storage.fileExists(at: fileURL) else {
            // No stats log has ever been written here — a fresh install's
            // honest starting state, not a failure to restore anything.
            let fresh = StatsLogFile.default
            cacheIfNeeded(fresh)
            return .restored(fresh)
        }

        do {
            let decoded = try await storage.read(StatsLogFile.self, from: fileURL)

            guard decoded.schemaVersion == StatsLogFile.currentSchemaVersion else {
                let fallback = StatsLogFile.default
                cacheIfNeeded(fallback)
                return .fallbackDefault(
                    fallback,
                    reason: .schemaMismatch(found: decoded.schemaVersion, expected: StatsLogFile.currentSchemaVersion)
                )
            }

            cacheIfNeeded(decoded)
            return .restored(decoded)
        } catch {
            let fallback = StatsLogFile.default
            cacheIfNeeded(fallback)
            return .fallbackDefault(fallback, reason: mapLoadError(error))
        }
    }

    public func save(_ model: StatsLogFile) async {
        if let pendingModel, pendingModel == model {
            return
        }
        if let lastPersistedModel, lastPersistedModel == model {
            return
        }

        pendingModel = model
        cachedModel = model
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.debounceFloorNanoseconds)
            if Task.isCancelled { return }

            await self.flushPendingWrite()
        }
    }

    public func append(_ event: StatsEvent) async {
        var model = cachedModel ?? await loadModelOrDefault()

        model.events.append(event)
        apply(event, to: &model)

        cachedModel = model
        await save(model)
    }

    public func flush() async {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = nil
        await flushPendingWrite()
    }

    private func flushPendingWrite() async {
        guard let model = pendingModel else { return }

        do {
            try await storage.writeAtomically(model, to: fileURL)
            pendingModel = nil
            lastPersistedModel = model
            cachedModel = model
        } catch {
            // Keep pendingModel intact so a later flush retries.
            return
        }
    }

    private func cacheIfNeeded(_ model: StatsLogFile) {
        cachedModel = model
        lastPersistedModel = model
        pendingModel = nil
    }

    private func loadModelOrDefault() async -> StatsLogFile {
        if let cachedModel {
            return cachedModel
        }

        switch await load() {
        case .restored(let model):
            return model
        case .fallbackDefault(let model, _):
            return model
        case .dataLoss(let reason):
            let fallback = StatsLogFile.default
            cachedModel = fallback
            _ = reason
            return fallback
        }
    }

    private func mapLoadError(_ error: Error) -> PersistenceError {
        switch error {
        case FileStorageError.invalidPayload:
            return .decodingFailed(description: "Could not decode stats log payload")
        case let FileStorageError.failedToRead(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToWrite(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory(description):
            return .ioFailed(description: description)
        default:
            return .ioFailed(description: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }

    private func apply(_ event: StatsEvent, to model: inout StatsLogFile) {
        var drawOne = model.drawOne
        var drawThree = model.drawThree

        switch event {
        case .gameStarted(_, let drawMode, let startedAt):
            var stats = drawMode == .drawOne ? drawOne : drawThree
            stats.gamesPlayed += 1
            stats.lastPlayedAt = startedAt
            if drawMode == .drawOne {
                drawOne = stats
            } else {
                drawThree = stats
            }

        case .gameEnded(_, let drawMode, let won, let elapsedSeconds, _):

            var stats = drawMode == .drawOne ? drawOne : drawThree
            let normalizedElapsed = elapsedSeconds.map { Int($0.rounded()) }

            if won {
                stats.gamesWon += 1
                stats.currentStreak += 1

                if let normalizedElapsed,
                   let bestSoFar = stats.bestTimeSeconds {
                    stats.bestTimeSeconds = min(bestSoFar, normalizedElapsed)
                } else if let normalizedElapsed {
                    stats.bestTimeSeconds = normalizedElapsed
                }
            } else {
                stats.currentStreak = 0
            }

            stats.lastPlayedAt = Date()

            if drawMode == .drawOne {
                drawOne = stats
            } else {
                drawThree = stats
            }
        }

        model.drawOne = drawOne
        model.drawThree = drawThree
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

import Foundation

public protocol StuckDetector: Sendable {
    func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool

struct StateMoveScanner {
    static func hasLegalMove(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        for tableauIndex in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            guard !tableau.isEmpty else { continue }

            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                let source = PileID.tableau(tableauIndex)
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: candidate)
                if !destinations.isEmpty {
                    return true
                }
            }
        }

        return false
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Canonical finite-state interaction contract for the game screen.
/// Game UI must derive all selection/highlight/ambiguity behavior from
/// this type, not from parallel @State booleans.
public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

    public func clearSelection() -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }
    }
}

/// exposes a live settings echo (or this view gets a second environment
/// dependency), the header always shows the raw elapsed time, which is
/// never a fabricated value, just uninformative while timing is off.
public struct GameView: View {

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme

            "Start a new game?",

            titleVisibility: .visible
        ) {

    }

    private var background: some View {
        Theme.Colors.scene(for: colorScheme).surfaceBase
            .ignoresSafeArea()
    }

    // MARK: - Header

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            Button {
                _ = engine.undo()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.uturn.backward")
                    .font(Theme.Fonts.headline)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("Undo")
            .accessibilityIdentifier(AccessibilityID.Game.undoButton)

            Spacer()

            Text(elapsedTimeText)
                .font(Theme.Fonts.monospacedStat)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .accessibilityLabel("Elapsed time \(elapsedTimeText)")

            Spacer()

            Button {
                if case .active = engine.state.terminalState {
                    isConfirmingNewGame = true
                } else {
                    engine.newGame(drawMode: engine.state.drawMode, requiresConfirmation: false)
                }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.clockwise")
                    .font(Theme.Fonts.headline)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("New Game")
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, Theme.Spacing.boardInset)
    }

    private var elapsedTimeText: String {
        let total = Int(engine.state.elapsedSeconds.rounded())
        return String(format: "%d:%02d", total / 60, total % 60)
    }

    // MARK: - Terminal overlay

    @ViewBuilder
    private var terminalOverlay: some View {
        switch engine.state.terminalState {
        case .active:
            EmptyView()
        case .won(let summary):
            WinOverlay(summary: summary) {
                engine.newGame(drawMode: engine.state.drawMode, requiresConfirmation: false)
            }
        case .stuck:
            if !stuckOverlayDismissed {
                StuckOverlay(
                    onNewGame: { engine.newGame(drawMode: engine.state.drawMode, requiresConfirmation: false) },
                    onContinue: { stuckOverlayDismissed = true }
                )
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Interaction routing

    /// Stock never appears in `legalDestinations` (Klondike never lets a
    /// card move back into stock), so it's special-cased ahead of the
    /// generic selected-source/destination routing rather than ever being
    /// treated as a selectable source.
    private func handleTap(_ pile: PileID, index: Int?) {
        if pile == .stock {
            engine.drawFromStock()
            return
        }

        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let destinations) = engine.interaction, destinations.contains(pile) {
            _ = engine.attemptMove(to: pile)
            return
        }

        guard let index else { return }
        engine.selectCard(pile: pile, index: index)
    }
}

final class DrawOneStuckDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorNeverFalsePositiveAfterLegalMoveSequences() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()
        var state = Self.dealtState(seed: 1)
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: 9_973)
        var legalStateCount = 0
        var seed: UInt64 = 1
        var loops = 0

        while legalStateCount < 10_000 && loops < 150_000 {
            loops += 1

            let actions = Self.legalActions(for: state)
            if actions.isEmpty {
                seed += 1
                state = Self.dealtState(seed: seed)
                continue
            }

            XCTAssertFalse(detector.isStuck(state), "Detected stuck in state with legal moves.")

            let action = actions.randomElement(using: &rng)!
            Self.apply(action, to: &state)

            legalStateCount += 1
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(legalStateCount, 10_000)
    }

    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorHasNoStockRecycleSimulationShortcut() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()

        let state = GameState(
            stock: [],
            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            foundations: [
                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .diamonds: [Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
                .spades: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            ],
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(detector.isStuck(state))
    }

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

    public init(mode: Binding<DrawMode>, hasActiveGame: Bool, onRequestChange: @escaping (DrawMode) -> Void) {
        self._mode = mode
        self.hasActiveGame = hasActiveGame
        self.onRequestChange = onRequestChange
    }

    public var body: some View {

            Text("Draw Mode")
                .font(Theme.Fonts.headline)

                Text("Draw One")
                    .tag(DrawMode.drawOne)
                    .accessibilityIdentifier("settings.drawModeSetting.drawOneOption")

        self.settingsStore = settingsStore
        self.haptics = haptics
        self.integrityService = integrity

        interaction = .idle

        currentSessionId = nil
        sessionStarted = false
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        settings = SettingsFile()
    }

        guard "'!bootstrapCompleted else { return }
        bootstrapCompleted = true

        async let loadedSettings = settingsStore.load()
        async let loadedGame = saveStore.load()

        settings = applySettingsRestore(await loadedSettings)

        switch await loadedGame {
        case .restored(let file):
            state = file.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: file.undoStack)

            if !isPlaceholderState(state),
               integrityService.validate(state) == .valid,
               canResumeState(state) {
                interaction = state.terminalState == .active ? .idle : .terminal(state.terminalState)
                resetInFlightSession(forReloadedActiveState: state)
            } else {
                sanitizeOrRefreshIfNeeded()
                startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())
            }

        case .fallbackDefault(let fallback, _):
            state = fallback.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: fallback.undoStack)
            startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())

        case .dataLoss:
            state = GameState()
            undoStack = UndoStack()
            startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())
        }
    }

    public func newGame(
        drawMode: DrawMode,
        requiresConfirmation: Bool,
        rng: any RandomNumberGenerator = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()
    ) {
        if case .active = state.terminalState {
            Task { await finalizeActiveSession(won: false) }
        }

        startFreshGame(drawMode: drawMode, rng: rng)
    }

    public func selectCard(pile: PileID, index: Int) {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            interaction = .idle
            return
        }

        switch pile {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            interaction = .idle
            return

        case .waste:
            guard let topIndex = state.waste.indices.last, topIndex == index else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }
            guard state.waste[topIndex].isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let legalDestinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            interaction = .sourceSelected(.waste, cardIndex: topIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)

            if case .sourceSelected(let source, let selectedIndex, let selectedDestinations) = interaction,
               source == .waste,
               selectedIndex == topIndex,
               legalDestinations == selectedDestinations {
                // keep as selected only if this call is coming from a fresh source
                // and legal destinations changed due to board changes.
            }

            if legalDestinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }

        case .tableau(let tableauIndex):
            guard state.tableau.indices.contains(tableauIndex) else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            guard state.tableau[tableauIndex].indices.contains(index) else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let card = state.tableau[tableauIndex][index]
            guard card.isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            guard RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: index) != nil else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let legalDestinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(
                in: state,
                source: .tableau(tableauIndex),
                sourceIndex: index
            )
            interaction = .sourceSelected(.tableau(tableauIndex), cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)

            if interaction == .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: legalDestinations) {

            }

            if legalDestinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }
        }

    public func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            return .blocked(reason: "Game is not active.")
        }
        guard case .sourceSelected(let source, let sourceIndex, _) = interaction else {
            return .blocked(reason: "No source selected.")
        }

        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination)

        switch outcome {
        case .executed(let move):
            snapshotForUndo()
            apply(move)
            startTimerIfNeededForAction()
            interaction = .resolvingMove(move)
            haptics.moveAccepted()
            postMutationRefresh()
            persistCurrentSnapshot()
            return outcome

        case .ambiguous:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            return outcome

        case .blocked:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()
            return outcome
        }
    }

    public func drawFromStock() {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else { return }
        guard !state.stock.isEmpty || !state.waste.isEmpty else { return }

        startTimerIfNeededForAction()

        if state.stock.isEmpty {
            recycleWasteToStock()
        } else {
            drawFromStockPile()
        }

        interaction = .idle
        postMutationRefresh()
        haptics.stockDraw()
        persistCurrentSnapshot()

    public func undo() -> Bool {
        guard let snapshot = undoStack.pop() else { return false }

        freezeTimerClock()
        state = snapshot.state
        restoreTimerState(for: snapshot.state)
        interaction = .idle
        sessionUndoCount += 1
        haptics.undo()
        undoStack = UndoStack(entries: undoStack.entries)
        persistCurrentSnapshot()
        return true
    }

    public func setDrawMode(_ mode: DrawMode) {
        guard state.drawMode != mode else { return }

        state.drawMode = mode
        settings.drawMode = mode
        persistSettings()

        if case .active = state.terminalState {
            interaction = .idle
        }
    }

    public func flushPersistence() async {
        persistCurrentSnapshot()
        await saveStore.flush()
        await statsStore.flush()
        await settingsStore.flush()
    }

    private func canResumeState(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        !state.stock.isEmpty || !state.waste.isEmpty ||
        state.tableau.contains { !$0.isEmpty } ||
        Suit.allCases.contains { !(state.foundations[$0] ?? []).isEmpty }
    }

    private func resetInFlightSession(forReloadedActiveState state: GameState) {
        currentSessionId = nil
        sessionStarted = false
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        interaction = state.terminalState == .active ? .idle : .terminal(state.terminalState)
        restoreTimerState(for: state)
    }

    private func sanitizeOrRefreshIfNeeded() {
        if case .active = state.terminalState,
           case .invalid(let reason) = integrityService.validate(state) {
            _ = reason
            state = GameState()
            undoStack = UndoStack()
            interaction = .idle
            state.terminalState = .active
        }
        if state.isTimerRunning {
            state.isTimerRunning = false
            state.startedAt = nil
            timerAnchor = nil
            timerTask?.cancel()
            timerTask = nil
        }
    }

    private func startFreshGame(drawMode: DrawMode, rng: any RandomNumberGenerator) {
        interaction = .dealing

        var shuffleRng = rng
        let deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &shuffleRng)
        var stock = deck
        var tableau = Array(repeating: [Card](), count: Self.cardTableauColumns)

        for column in 0..<Self.cardTableauColumns {
            for row in 0...column {
                var card = stock.removeLast()
                card.isFaceUp = row == column
                tableau[column].append(card)
            }
        }

        let foundations = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, [Card]()) })

        self.state = GameState(
            stock: stock,
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: drawMode,
            elapsedSeconds: 0,
            isTimerRunning: false,
            startedAt: nil,
            terminalState: .active
        )

        timerAnchor = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = 0
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil

        undoStack = UndoStack()
        currentSessionId = UUID()
        sessionStarted = false
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        settings.drawMode = drawMode

        finalizeInteractionAfterDeal()
        beginNewSessionIfNeeded()
        persistCurrentSnapshot()
    }

    private func finalizeInteractionAfterDeal() {
        Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.tableauDealingDelayNanos)
            await MainActor.run {
                if case .dealing = interaction {
                    interaction = .idle
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func beginNewSessionIfNeeded() {
        guard !sessionStarted, let sessionId = currentSessionId else { return }
        guard sessionStarted == false else { return }
        guard let latestSessionId = stateTerminalActiveSessionIdFallback() else { return }
        _ = latestSessionId
        sessionStarted = true
        Task {
            await statsStore.append(
                .gameStarted(
                    sessionId: sessionId,
                    drawMode: state.drawMode,
                    startedAt: Date()
                )
            )
        }
    }

    private func stateTerminalActiveSessionIdFallback() -> UUID? {
        if state.terminalState == .active {
            return currentSessionId
        }
        return nil
    }

    private func postMutationRefresh() {
        switch state.terminalState {
        case .won:
            return
        case .stuck:
            return
        case .active:
            break
        }

        if isWinState(state) {
            finalizeWin()
            return
        }

        if shouldDetectStuck(state) {
            finalizeStuck()
            return
        }

        interaction = .idle
    }

    private func isWinState(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        Suit.allCases.allSatisfy { (state.foundations[$0] ?? []).count == 13 }
    }

    private func shouldDetectStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else { return false }
        let detector: StuckDetector = state.drawMode == .drawOne ? DrawOneStuckDetector() : DrawThreeStuckDetector()
        return detector.isStuck(state)
    }

    private func finalizeWin() {
        let elapsed = stopTimerAndReturnElapsed(enabled: settings.timerEnabled)
        let summary = WinSummary(elapsedSeconds: elapsed, drawMode: state.drawMode, undoCount: sessionUndoCount)

        state.terminalState = .won(summary)
        interaction = .terminal(.won(summary))
        haptics.won()

        Task {
            await finalizeActiveSession(won: true, elapsedOverride: elapsed)
        }
    }

    private func finalizeStuck() {
        state.terminalState = .stuck
        interaction = .terminal(.stuck)
        haptics.stuckDetected()

        Task {
            await finalizeActiveSession(won: false)
        }
    }

    private func finalizeActiveSession(won: Bool, elapsedOverride: TimeInterval? = nil) async {
        guard sessionStarted, let sessionId = currentSessionId else { return }

        let elapsed = elapsedOverride ?? stopTimerAndReturnElapsed(enabled: settings.timerEnabled)
        await statsStore.append(
            .gameEnded(
                sessionId: sessionId,
                drawMode: state.drawMode,
                won: won,
                elapsedSeconds: elapsed,
                undoCount: sessionUndoCount
            )
        )

        sessionStarted = false
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        currentSessionId = nil
    }

    private func snapshotForUndo() {
        let snapshot = GameStateSnapshot(state: state)
        undoStack.push(snapshot)
    }

    private func drawFromStockPile() {
        let drawCount = state.drawMode == .drawOne ? 1 : 3

        var drawn: [Card] = []
        for _ in 0..<drawCount {
            guard let next = state.stock.popLast() else { break }
            var card = next
            card.isFaceUp = true
            drawn.append(card)
        }

        guard !drawn.isEmpty else { return }
        state.waste.append(contentsOf: drawn)
    }

import Foundation
import Observation

@MainActor
@Observable
public final class GameEngine {
    public private(set) var state: GameState
    public private(set) var interaction: InteractionState

    private let saveStore: GameSaveStore
    private let statsStore: StatsLogStore
    private let settingsStore: SettingsStore
    private let haptics: HapticsService
    private let integrityService: RestoreIntegrityService

    private var undoStack: UndoStack
    private var timerTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var timerAnchor: Date?
    private var timerAnchorElapsed: TimeInterval

    private var bootstrapCompleted: Bool
    private var currentSessionId: UUID?
    private var sessionStarted: Bool
    private var sessionUndoCount: Int
    private var settings: SettingsFile

    private var pendingPersist: Task<Void, Never>?

    private static let cardTableauColumns = 7
    private static let tableauDealingDelayNanos: UInt64 = 240_000_000

    public init(
        saveStore: GameSaveStore,
        statsStore: StatsLogStore,
        settingsStore: SettingsStore,
        haptics: HapticsService,
        integrity: RestoreIntegrityService
    ) {
        self.saveStore = saveStore
        self.statsStore = statsStore
        self.settingsStore = settingsStore
        self.haptics = haptics
        self.integrityService = integrity

        state = GameState()
        interaction = .idle
        undoStack = UndoStack()

        timerAnchorElapsed = 0
        bootstrapCompleted = false
        currentSessionId = nil
        sessionStarted = false
        sessionUndoCount = 0
        settings = SettingsFile()
    }

    public func bootstrap() async {
        guard !bootstrapCompleted else { return }
        bootstrapCompleted = true

        async let loadedSettings = settingsStore.load()
        async let loadedGame = saveStore.load()

        settings = applySettingsRestore(await loadedSettings)

        switch await loadedGame {
        case .restored(let file):
            state = file.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: file.undoStack)

            if !isPlaceholderState(state),
               integrityService.validate(state) == .valid,
               canResumeState(state) {
                interaction = state.terminalState == .active ? .idle : .terminal(state.terminalState)
                resetInFlightSession(forReloadedActiveState: state)
            } else {
                sanitizeOrRefreshIfNeeded()
                startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())
            }

        case .fallbackDefault(let fallback, _):
            state = fallback.state
            undoStack = UndoStack(entries: fallback.undoStack)
            startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())

        case .dataLoss:
            state = GameState()
            undoStack = UndoStack()
            startFreshGame(drawMode: settings.drawMode, rng: SystemRandomNumberGenerator())
        }
    }

    public func newGame(
        drawMode: DrawMode,
        requiresConfirmation: Bool,
        rng: any RandomNumberGenerator = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()
    ) {
        if case .active = state.terminalState {
            Task { await finalizeActiveSession(won: false) }
        }

        startFreshGame(drawMode: drawMode, rng: rng)
    }

    public func selectCard(pile: PileID, index: Int) {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            interaction = .idle
            return
        }

        switch pile {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            interaction = .idle
            return

        case .waste:
            guard let topIndex = state.waste.indices.last, topIndex == index else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }
            guard state.waste[topIndex].isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let legalDestinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            interaction = .sourceSelected(.waste, cardIndex: topIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)

            if case .sourceSelected(let source, let selectedIndex, let selectedDestinations) = interaction,
               source == .waste,
               selectedIndex == topIndex,
               legalDestinations == selectedDestinations {
                // keep as selected only if this call is coming from a fresh source
                // and legal destinations changed due to board changes.
            }

            if legalDestinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }

        case .tableau(let tableauIndex):
            guard state.tableau.indices.contains(tableauIndex) else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            guard state.tableau[tableauIndex].indices.contains(index) else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let card = state.tableau[tableauIndex][index]
            guard card.isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            guard RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: index) != nil else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let legalDestinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(
                in: state,
                source: .tableau(tableauIndex),
                sourceIndex: index
            )
            interaction = .sourceSelected(.tableau(tableauIndex), cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)

            if interaction == .sourceSelected(pile, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: legalDestinations) {
                // kept for symmetry with no-op selection update semantics
            }

            if legalDestinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }
        }
    }

    public func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            return .blocked(reason: "Game is not active.")

        guard case .sourceSelected(let source, let sourceIndex, _) = interaction else {
            return .blocked(reason: "No source selected.")

        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination)

            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)

        case .blocked:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()
            return outcome
        }
    }

    public func drawFromStock() {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else { return }

import Foundation

public struct GameState: Equatable, Sendable {
    public var stock: [Card]
    public var waste: [Card]
    public var foundations: [Suit: [Card]]
    public var tableau: [[Card]]
    public var drawMode: DrawMode
    public var elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval
    public var isTimerRunning: Bool
    public var startedAt: Date?
    public var terminalState: TerminalState

    public init(
        stock: [Card] = [],
        waste: [Card] = [],
        foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) }),
        tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
        drawMode: DrawMode = .drawOne,
        elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval = 0,
        isTimerRunning: Bool = false,
        startedAt: Date? = nil,
        terminalState: TerminalState = .active
    ) {
        self.stock = stock
        self.waste = waste
        self.foundations = foundations
        self.tableau = tableau
        self.drawMode = drawMode
        self.elapsedSeconds = elapsedSeconds
        self.isTimerRunning = isTimerRunning
        self.startedAt = startedAt
        self.terminalState = terminalState
    }
}

public extension GameState {
    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case stock, waste, foundations, tableau, drawMode, elapsedSeconds, isTimerRunning, startedAt, terminalState
    }
}

extension GameState: Codable {
    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        stock = try container.decode([Card].self, forKey: .stock)
        waste = try container.decode([Card].self, forKey: .waste)
        tableau = try container.decode([[Card]].self, forKey: .tableau)
        drawMode = try container.decode(DrawMode.self, forKey: .drawMode)
        elapsedSeconds = try container.decode(TimeInterval.self, forKey: .elapsedSeconds)
        isTimerRunning = try container.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .isTimerRunning)
        startedAt = try container.decodeIfPresent(Date.self, forKey: .startedAt)
        terminalState = try container.decode(TerminalState.self, forKey: .terminalState)

        let foundationsBySuitName = try container.decode([String: [Card]].self, forKey: .foundations)
        var decodedFoundations: [Suit: [Card]] = [:]
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            decodedFoundations[suit] = foundationsBySuitName[suit.rawValue] ?? []
        }
        foundations = decodedFoundations
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try container.encode(stock, forKey: .stock)
        try container.encode(waste, forKey: .waste)
        try container.encode(tableau, forKey: .tableau)
        try container.encode(drawMode, forKey: .drawMode)
        try container.encode(elapsedSeconds, forKey: .elapsedSeconds)
        try container.encode(isTimerRunning, forKey: .isTimerRunning)
        try container.encodeIfPresent(startedAt, forKey: .startedAt)
        try container.encode(terminalState, forKey: .terminalState)

        let foundationsBySuitName = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: foundations.map { ($0.key.rawValue, $0.value) })
        try container.encode(foundationsBySuitName, forKey: .foundations)
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum MoveValidator {
    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        switch destinations.count {
        case 0:
            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
        case 1:
            return .executed(Move(
                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
                source: source,
                destination: destinations[0]
            ))
        default:
            return .ambiguous(
                source: source,
                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
                destinations: destinations
            )
        }
    }

    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let cards else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [PileID] {
        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let movingCards else { return [] }

        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
        var destinations: [PileID] = []

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
                destinations.append(foundation)
            }
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
            if tableau == source { continue }

            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
                destinations.append(tableau)
            }
        }

        return destinations
    }

    public static func movingCards(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [Card]? {
        switch source {
        case .stock:
            return nil
        case .waste:
            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
            return [top]
        case .foundation:
            return nil
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard let sourceIndex else {
                return nil
            }
            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
        }
    }

    public static func isLegal(
        cards: [Card],
        source: PileID,
        destination: PileID,
        state: GameState
    ) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
        let head = cards[0]

        switch destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            return false
        case .foundation(let suit):
            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            if destination == source { return false }
            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
        }
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        guard let destinationTop else {
            return card.rank == .king
        }
        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
        if let top = destination.last {
            return top.isFaceUp &&
            top.suit == card.suit &&
            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
        }
        return card.rank == .ace
    }

    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> String {
        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
            return "No legal move source selected."
        }
        return "No legal destination for selected card."
    }

    private static func moveBlockedReason(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> String {
        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
            return "Invalid source for move."
        }
        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
            return "No cards selected."
        }
        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
            return "Destination is not legal."
        }
        return "Move blocked."
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

import Foundation

public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
    private enum Constants {
        static let maxDepth = 200
    }

    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]

    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
        self.entries = entries
    }

    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
        entries.append(snapshot)
        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
        }
    }

    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
        return entries.popLast()
    }

    public var isEmpty: Bool {
        entries.isEmpty
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Draw-1 stuck detection.
///
/// Exact static legality pass: no stock-cycle simulation.
public struct DrawOneStuckDetector: StuckDetector {
    public init() {}

    public func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            return false
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let wasteTopMoves = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if !wasteTopMoves.isEmpty {
                return false
            }
        }

        return !StateMoveScanner.hasLegalMove(state)
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Draw-3 stuck detection.
///
/// Conservative approximation for draw-3 mode: unlike draw-1's exact static pass,
/// stock cards are treated as a future, hypothetical waste stream. Any remaining stock
/// means a future draw can expose additional candidates, so we never report a hard stuck
/// while stock exists (no false-positive stuck). This deliberately favors avoiding false
/// positives over perfect draw-cycle accuracy; exact reachability is out of scope for this
/// build slice.
public struct DrawThreeStuckDetector: StuckDetector {
    public init() {}

    public func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            return false
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let wasteTopMoves = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if !wasteTopMoves.isEmpty {
                return false
            }
        }

        return !StateMoveScanner.hasLegalMove(state)
    }
}

public enum DeckFactory {
    public static func orderedCards() -> [Card] {
        Suit.allCases.flatMap { suit in
            Rank.allCases.map { Card(suit: suit, rank: $0, isFaceUp: false) }
        }
    }

    public static func shuffledCards(
        shuffler: DeckShuffler = StandardDeckShuffler(),
        rng: inout any RandomNumberGenerator
    ) -> [Card] {
        var cards = orderedCards()
        shuffler.shuffle(&cards, using: &rng)
        return cards
    }
}

public struct StandardDeckShuffler: DeckShuffler {
    public init() {}

    public func shuffle(_ cards: inout [Card], using rng: inout any RandomNumberGenerator) {
        cards.shuffle(using: &rng)

import Foundation

/// Canonical finite-state interaction contract for the game screen.
/// Game UI must derive all selection/highlight/ambiguity behavior from
/// this type, not from parallel @State booleans.
public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

    public func clearSelection() -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

import Foundation
import UIKit

protocol HapticsService: Sendable {
    func moveAccepted()
    func blockedMove()
    func stockDraw()
    func undo()
    func won()
    func stuckDetected()
}

final class DefaultHapticsService: HapticsService, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let rigidImpact = UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .rigid)
    private let lightImpact = UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .light)
    private let notificationFeedback = UINotificationFeedbackGenerator()

    init() {
        rigidImpact.prepare()
        lightImpact.prepare()
        notificationFeedback.prepare()
    }

    func moveAccepted() {
        triggerImpact(rigidImpact, intensity: 0.55)
    }

    func blockedMove() {
        triggerImpact(rigidImpact, intensity: 0.9)
    }

    func stockDraw() {
        triggerImpact(lightImpact, intensity: 0.45)
    }

    func undo() {
        triggerImpact(lightImpact, intensity: 0.35)
    }

    func won() {
        triggerNotification(.success)
    }

    func stuckDetected() {
        triggerNotification(.warning)
    }

    private func triggerImpact(_ generator: UIImpactFeedbackGenerator, intensity: CGFloat) {
        generator.prepare()
        generator.impactOccurred(intensity: intensity)
    }

    private func triggerNotification(_ type: UINotificationFeedbackGenerator.FeedbackType) {
        notificationFeedback.prepare()
        notificationFeedback.notificationOccurred(type)
    }
}
