import Foundation

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

final class DrawOneStuckDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorNeverFalsePositiveAfterLegalMoveSequences() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()
        var state = Self.dealtState(seed: 1)
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: 9_973)
        var legalStateCount = 0
        var seed: UInt64 = 1
        var loops = 0

        while legalStateCount < 10_000 && loops < 150_000 {
            loops += 1

            let actions = Self.legalActions(for: state)
            if actions.isEmpty {
                seed += 1
                state = Self.dealtState(seed: seed)
                continue
            }

            XCTAssertFalse(detector.isStuck(state), "Detected stuck in state with legal moves.")

            let action = actions.randomElement(using: &rng)!
            Self.apply(action, to: &state)

            legalStateCount += 1
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(legalStateCount, 10_000)
    }

    func testDrawOneStuckDetectorHasNoStockRecycleSimulationShortcut() {
        let detector = DrawOneStuckDetector()

        let state = GameState(
            stock: [],
            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            foundations: [
                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .diamonds: [Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
                .spades: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
            ],
            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )

        XCTAssertTrue(detector.isStuck(state))
    }

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {

                        let (offset, card) = pair
                        cardView(card, pile: .waste, index: waste.count - visible.count + offset)
                            .offset(x: CGFloat(offset) * cardWidth * 0.22)

        .frame(width: cardWidth * 1.4, height: cardHeight, alignment: .leading)
    }

    private var foundationRow: some View {
        HStack(spacing: Theme.Spacing.pileGap) {

        return Group {

            if cards.isEmpty {

                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                    .onTapGesture { onTap(.tableau(column), nil) }
                    .accessibilityIdentifier(AccessibilityID.tableauTopCard(column: column))

                    cardView(card, pile: .tableau(column), index: index)
                        .offset(y: CGFloat(index) * overlapStep)
                        .zIndex(Double(index))

        CardView(card: card, state: visualState(for: pile, index: index))
            .frame(width: cardWidth, height: cardHeight)
            .contentShape(Rectangle())

        switch pile {
        case .stock: return index == engine.state.stock.count - 1
        case .waste: return index == engine.state.waste.count - 1
        case .foundation(let suit): return index == (engine.state.foundations[suit]?.count ?? 0) - 1

    private func topCardIdentifier(pile: PileID, index: Int) -> String {
        guard isTopIndex(pile: pile, index: index) else {
            return "game.\(pileSlug(pile)).card\(index)"
        }
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return AccessibilityID.Game.stockPile
        case .waste: return "game.wastePile.topCard"
        case .foundation(let suit): return AccessibilityID.foundation(suit)
        case .tableau(let column): return AccessibilityID.tableauTopCard(column: column)
        }
    }

    private func pileSlug(_ pile: PileID) -> String {
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return "stockPile"
        case .waste: return "wastePile"
        case .foundation(let suit): return "foundation.\(suit.rawValue)"
        case .tableau(let column): return "tableau.column\(column)"

    }

    private func pileDescription(_ pile: PileID) -> String {
        switch pile {
        case .stock: return "stock"
        case .waste: return "waste"
        case .foundation(let suit): return "foundation, \(suitName(suit))"
        case .tableau(let column): return "tableau column \(column + 1)"
        }
    }

    private func suitName(_ suit: Suit) -> String {
        switch suit {
        case .clubs: return "Clubs"
        case .diamonds: return "Diamonds"
        case .hearts: return "Hearts"
        case .spades: return "Spades"
        }

                    Image(systemName: systemHint)
                        .foregroundStyle(Theme.Card.frontEdge.opacity(0.6))
                }
            }
            .accessibilityLabel(label)

import Foundation
import Combine

@MainActor
public final class AppRestoreCoordinator: ObservableObject {
    @Published public private(set) var hasFinishedInitialLoad: Bool = false
    @Published public private(set) var gameRestoreOutcome: RestoreOutcome<GameSaveFile> = .restored(GameSaveFile.default)
    @Published public private(set) var statsRestoreOutcome: RestoreOutcome<StatsLogFile> = .restored(StatsLogFile.default)
    @Published public private(set) var settingsRestoreOutcome: RestoreOutcome<SettingsFile> = .restored(SettingsFile.default)

    private var isRestoring: Bool = false

    public init() {}

    /// Delegates wording to `Interaction/RecoveryCopy` rather than owning a
    /// second copy of it — this and `RecoveryCopy` were built in the same
    /// parallel round without either lane seeing the other, and had already
    /// drifted (this property said "Couldn't restore settings" where
    /// `RecoveryCopy` said "Couldn't save settings") before anyone noticed.
    public var gameRecoveryMessage: String? {
        switch gameRestoreOutcome {
        case .fallbackDefault(_, let reason), .dataLoss(let reason):
            return RecoveryCopy.gameRecoveryBannerMessage(for: reason)
        case .restored:
            return nil
        }
    }

    public var settingsRecoveryMessage: String? {
        switch settingsRestoreOutcome {
        case .fallbackDefault(_, let reason), .dataLoss(let reason):
            return RecoveryCopy.settingsFallbackToastMessage(for: reason)
        case .restored:
            return nil
        }
    }

    /// Generic over anything conforming to `PersistenceStore` with the right
    /// `Model` — not just the concrete `GameSaveStore`/`StatsLogStore`/
    /// `SettingsStore` — so unit tests can substitute a lightweight mock
    /// store (see `TrackedStore` in `AppRestoreCoordinatorTests`) instead of
    /// exercising the real file system. A concrete-typed signature here
    /// would make that substitution a compile error.
    public func restoreAll<
        GameStore: PersistenceStore,
        StatsStore: PersistenceStore,
        SettingsStoreType: PersistenceStore
    >(
        gameStore: GameStore,
        statsStore: StatsStore,
        settingsStore: SettingsStoreType
    ) async where
        GameStore.Model == GameSaveFile,
        StatsStore.Model == StatsLogFile,
        SettingsStoreType.Model == SettingsFile
    {
        guard !hasFinishedInitialLoad, !isRestoring else {
            return
        }

        isRestoring = true
        defer {
            isRestoring = false
            hasFinishedInitialLoad = true
        }

        async let loadedGame = gameStore.load()
        async let loadedStats = statsStore.load()
        async let loadedSettings = settingsStore.load()

        gameRestoreOutcome = await loadedGame
        statsRestoreOutcome = await loadedStats
        settingsRestoreOutcome = await loadedSettings
    }
}

import Foundation

enum FileStorageError: Error, Sendable {
    case failedToCreateDirectory(String)
    case failedToRead(String)
    case failedToWrite(String)
    case invalidPayload
}

struct AtomicFileWriter: Sendable {
    typealias PreSwapHook = (URL) throws -> Void

    private let onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook?

    init(onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook? = nil) {
        self.onBeforeSwap = onBeforeSwap
    }

    func write<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to url: URL) throws {
        let containerURL = url.deletingLastPathComponent()

        do {
            try createDirectoryIfNeeded(at: containerURL)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory("could not create parent directory for \(url.path): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }

        let data = try encode(value)
        let tempURL = containerURL.appendingPathComponent(".\(url.lastPathComponent).tmp-\(UUID().uuidString)")

        do {
            try data.write(to: tempURL, options: .atomic)
            try onBeforeSwap?(tempURL)
            // replaceItemAt consumes/moves the item at tempURL into place —
            // there is nothing left at tempURL to remove afterward. Removing
            // it here (as a prior version did) throws "no such file" on
            // every successful save and gets caught below as a false write
            // failure, which is exactly the "app lies about the player's
            // own data" bug class this project exists to avoid.
            try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(url, withItemAt: tempURL)
        } catch {
            _ = try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)
            if let error = error as? FileStorageError {
                throw error
            }
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("atomic write failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from url: URL) throws -> T {
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
            throw FileStorageError.invalidPayload
        }

        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(type, from: data)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToRead("decode failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func createDirectoryIfNeeded(at url: URL) throws {
        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else { return }
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    }

    private func encode<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> Data {
        do {
            return try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("encoding failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }
}

final class FileStorage: Sendable {
    private let rootURL: URL

    init(rootURL: URL) {
        self.rootURL = rootURL
    }

    private func resolvedURL(for fileURL: URL) -> URL {
        fileURL.path.hasPrefix("/") ? fileURL : rootURL.appendingPathComponent(fileURL.lastPathComponent)
    }

    /// Whether a file genuinely exists at `fileURL` yet. Callers use this to
    /// distinguish "nothing has ever been saved here" (the legitimate,
    /// honest starting state on a fresh install — not a failure) from "a
    /// file exists but couldn't be read/decoded" (a real error `read`
    /// should surface). Without this distinction every first launch would
    /// report the identical error as genuine corruption, since
    /// `AtomicFileWriter.read` throws the same `.invalidPayload` for both.
    func fileExists(at fileURL: URL) -> Bool {
        FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: resolvedURL(for: fileURL).path)
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from fileURL: URL) async throws -> T {
        try AtomicFileWriter().read(type, from: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }

    func writeAtomically<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to fileURL: URL) async throws {
        try AtomicFileWriter().write(value, to: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }
}

        self.bootstrapCompleted = false
    }

        guard "'!bootstrapCompleted else { return }
        bootstrapCompleted = true

        let loadedSettings = await settingsStore.load()
        settings = applySettingsRestore(loadedSettings)

        let loadedGame = await saveStore.load()
        await restoreGameState(loadedGame)
    }

    public func newGame(
        drawMode: DrawMode,
        requiresConfirmation: Bool,
        rng: any RandomNumberGenerator = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()
    ) {
        _ = requiresConfirmation

        if case .active = state.terminalState, currentSessionId != nil {
            finalizeActiveSession(won: false, forcedAbandon: true)
        }

        var mutableRng = rng
        startFreshGame(drawMode: drawMode, emitGameStarted: true, rng: &mutableRng)
    }

    public func selectCard(pile: PileID, index: Int) {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            interaction = .idle
            return
        }

        switch pile {
        case .stock, .foundation:
            interaction = .idle
            return

        case .waste:
            guard index >= 0,
                  index == state.waste.count - 1,
                  index < state.waste.count,
                  state.waste[index].isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            if case .sourceSelected(.waste, let selectedIndex, _) = interaction,
               selectedIndex == index {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            interaction = interaction.transitionToSelectedSource(.waste, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: destinations)

            if destinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }

        case .tableau(let tableauIndex):
            guard tableauIndex >= 0,
                  tableauIndex < state.tableau.count,
                  index >= 0,
                  index < state.tableau[tableauIndex].count else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let selectedCard = state.tableau[tableauIndex][index]
            guard selectedCard.isFaceUp else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            guard RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: index) != nil else {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            if case .sourceSelected(.tableau(let activeColumn), let activeIndex, _) = interaction,
               activeColumn == tableauIndex,
               activeIndex == index {
                interaction = .idle
                return
            }

            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(
                in: state,
                source: .tableau(tableauIndex),
                sourceIndex: index
            )

            interaction = interaction.transitionToSelectedSource(
                .tableau(tableauIndex),
                cardIndex: index,
                legalDestinations: destinations
            )

            if destinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))
                haptics.blockedMove()
            }
        }
    }

    public func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            let blocked = MoveOutcome.blocked(reason: "Game is not active.")
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: blocked)
            return blocked
        }

        guard case .sourceSelected(let source, let sourceIndex, _) = interaction else {
            let blocked = MoveOutcome.blocked(reason: "No source selected.")
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: blocked)
            return blocked
        }

        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(
            in: state,
            source: source,
            sourceIndex: sourceIndex,
            destination: destination
        )

        switch outcome {
        case .executed(let move):
            snapshotForUndo()
            apply(move)
            interaction = .resolvingMove(move)
            haptics.moveAccepted()
            startTimerIfNeededForAction()
            postMutationRefresh()
            persistCurrentSnapshot()
            return outcome

        case .ambiguous(let source, let cardIndex, let destinations):
            interaction = .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)
            return outcome

        case .blocked:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()
            return outcome
        }
    }

        if state.stock.isEmpty {

        } else {

        postMutationRefresh()
        persistCurrentSnapshot()
    }

        guard let snapshot = undoStack.pop() else {
            return false
        }

        freezeTimerClock()
        state = snapshot.state
        currentSessionUndoCount += 1
        restoreTimerState(from: state)
        interaction = state.terminalState == .active ? .idle : .terminal(state.terminalState)
        haptics.undo()
        persistCurrentSnapshot()
        return true
    }

    public func setDrawMode(_ mode: DrawMode) {
        guard state.drawMode != mode else { return }

        state.drawMode = mode
        settings.drawMode = mode

        if case .active = state.terminalState {
            finalizeActiveSession(won: false, forcedAbandon: true)
            startFreshGame(drawMode: mode, emitGameStarted: true)
        }

        interaction = interaction.clearSelection()
        persistSettings()
    }

        await settingsStore.flush()

        switch outcome {

                    drawMode: state.drawMode,
                    undoCount: currentSessionUndoCount
                )
            )
        }

        if isStuck(state) {
            return .stuck
        }

        return .active
    }

    private func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        let detector: StuckDetector = state.drawMode == .drawOne ? DrawOneStuckDetector() : DrawThreeStuckDetector()
        return detector.isStuck(state)
    }

    private func allFoundationsComplete() -> Bool {
        Suit.allCases.allSatisfy { suit in
            state.foundations[suit]?.count == 13

    private func snapshotForUndo() {

        undoStack.push(snapshot)
        interaction = interaction.clearSelection()

    private func finalizeActiveSession(won: Bool, elapsedSeconds: TimeInterval? = nil, forcedAbandon: Bool = false) {
        guard let sessionId = currentSessionId else {
            return
        }

        if won || forcedAbandon {
            let resolved = settings.timerEnabled ? (elapsedSeconds ?? stopTimerAndReturnElapsed()) : nil
            Task {
                await statsStore.append(
                    .gameEnded(
                        sessionId: sessionId,
                        drawMode: state.drawMode,
                        won: won,
                        elapsedSeconds: resolved,
                        undoCount: currentSessionUndoCount
                    )
                )
            }

            currentSessionId = nil
            currentSessionUndoCount = 0
        }

        guard settings.timerEnabled else { return }
        guard !state.isTimerRunning else {

            state.startedAt = Date()
        }

        state.isTimerRunning = true
        timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
        timerAnchor = Date()
        startTimerTask()
    }

    private func startTimerTask() {
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = Task { [weak self] in
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
                guard let self else { return }

                await MainActor.run {
                    guard self.state.isTimerRunning,
                          let anchor = self.timerAnchor,
                          self.settings.timerEnabled else { return }

                    self.state.elapsedSeconds = self.timerAnchorElapsed + Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func freezeTimerClock() {
        guard state.isTimerRunning, let anchor = timerAnchor else {
            timerTask?.cancel()
            timerTask = nil
            timerAnchor = nil
            return
        }

        state.elapsedSeconds += Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
        state.isTimerRunning = false
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
    }

    private func stopTimerAndReturnElapsed() -> TimeInterval {
        guard settings.timerEnabled else { return state.elapsedSeconds }
        guard state.isTimerRunning else { return state.elapsedSeconds }
        freezeTimerClock()
        return state.elapsedSeconds
    }

    private func restoreTimerState(from stateToRestore: GameState) {
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = stateToRestore.elapsedSeconds

        if !settings.timerEnabled || !stateToRestore.isTimerRunning || stateToRestore.terminalState != .active {
            state.isTimerRunning = false
            return
        }

        self.state.isTimerRunning = true
        timerAnchor = Date()
        startTimerTask()
    }

    private func persistCurrentSnapshot() {
        Task {
            await persistCurrentSnapshotNow()
        }
    }

    private func persistCurrentSnapshotNow() async {
        let snapshot = GameSaveFile(
            schemaVersion: GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion,
            state: state,
            undoStack: undoStack.entries
        )
        await saveStore.save(snapshot)
    }

    private func persistSettings() {
        Task {
            let updated = settings
            var file = updated
            file.drawMode = state.drawMode
            await settingsStore.save(file)
        }
    }

    private func scheduleDealCompletionIfNeeded() {
        let token = UUID()
        dealingToken = token

            await MainActor.run {

                      self.dealingToken == token,
                      case .dealing = self.interaction else {
                    return
                }
                self.interaction = .idle

    private static let tableauSlots = 7

    private enum SimulationAction {
        case drawFromStock
        case move(source: PileID, destination: PileID, cards: [Card])
    }

    private static func legalActions(for state: GameState) -> [SimulationAction] {
        var actions: [SimulationAction] = []

        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            actions.append(.drawFromStock)
        }

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if let card = state.waste.last {
                destinations.forEach { actions.append(.move(source: .waste, destination: $0, cards: [card])) }
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }

import Foundation

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Canonical finite-state interaction contract for the game screen.
/// Game UI must derive all selection/highlight/ambiguity behavior from
/// this type, not from parallel @State booleans.
public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

    public func clearSelection() -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }
    }
}

import Foundation

public enum MoveValidator {
    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        switch destinations.count {
        case 0:
            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
        case 1:
            return .executed(Move(
                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
                source: source,
                destination: destinations[0]
            ))
        default:
            return .ambiguous(
                source: source,
                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
                destinations: destinations
            )
        }
    }

    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let cards else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [PileID] {
        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let movingCards else { return [] }

        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
        var destinations: [PileID] = []

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
                destinations.append(foundation)
            }
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
            if tableau == source { continue }

            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
                destinations.append(tableau)
            }
        }

        return destinations
    }

    public static func movingCards(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [Card]? {
        switch source {
        case .stock:
            return nil
        case .waste:
            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
            return [top]
        case .foundation:
            return nil
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard let sourceIndex else {
                return nil
            }
            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
        }
    }

    public static func isLegal(
        cards: [Card],
        source: PileID,
        destination: PileID,
        state: GameState
    ) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
        let head = cards[0]

        switch destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            return false
        case .foundation(let suit):
            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            if destination == source { return false }
            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
        }
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        guard let destinationTop else {
            return card.rank == .king
        }
        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
        if let top = destination.last {
            return top.isFaceUp &&
            top.suit == card.suit &&
            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
        }
        return card.rank == .ace
    }

    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> String {
        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
            return "No legal move source selected."
        }
        return "No legal destination for selected card."
    }

    private static func moveBlockedReason(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> String {
        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
            return "Invalid source for move."
        }
        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
            return "No cards selected."
        }
        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
            return "Destination is not legal."
        }
        return "Move blocked."
    }
}

/// Draw-3 stuck detection.
///
/// Conservative approximation for draw-3 mode: unlike draw-1's exact static pass,
/// stock cards are treated as a future, hypothetical waste stream. Any remaining stock
/// means a future draw can expose additional candidates, so we never report a hard stuck
/// while stock exists (no false-positive stuck). This deliberately favors avoiding false
/// positives over perfect draw-cycle accuracy; exact reachability is out of scope for this
/// build slice.
public struct DrawThreeStuckDetector: StuckDetector {
    public init() {}

    public func isStuck(_ state: GameState) -> Bool {
        if !state.stock.isEmpty {
            return false

        if !state.waste.isEmpty {
            let wasteTopMoves = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            if !wasteTopMoves.isEmpty {
                return false
            }
        }

        return !StateMoveScanner.hasLegalMove(state)
    }
}

public actor GameSaveStore: PersistenceStore {
    public typealias Model = GameSaveFile

    // Floor per DEC-project_plan-005 / DEC-project_plan-006: debounce is fixed
    // at 0.35s to prevent debounce-sensitivity regressions from changing I/O
    // cadence and causing in-flight animation hitches.
    public static let debounceFloorSeconds: TimeInterval = 0.35
    public static let debounceFloorNanoseconds: UInt64 = UInt64(debounceFloorSeconds * 1_000_000_000)

    private let fileURL: URL
    private let storage: FileStorage
    private let integrityService: DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService

    private var pendingWrite: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var pendingModel: GameSaveFile?
    private var lastPersistedModel: GameSaveFile?

    public init(
        fileURL: URL,
        storage: FileStorage = FileStorage(rootURL: URL.standardPersistenceDirectory()),
        integrityService: DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService = .init()
    ) {
        self.fileURL = fileURL
        self.storage = storage
        self.integrityService = integrityService
    }

    deinit {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
    }

    public func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<GameSaveFile> {
        guard storage.fileExists(at: fileURL) else {
            // No save has ever been written here — a fresh install's honest
            // starting state, not a failure to restore anything.
            let fresh = GameSaveFile.default
            cacheRestored(fresh)
            return .restored(fresh)
        }

        do {
            let decoded = try await storage.read(GameSaveFile.self, from: fileURL)

            guard decoded.schemaVersion == GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion else {
                return .fallbackDefault(
                    GameSaveFile.default,
                    reason: .schemaMismatch(
                        found: decoded.schemaVersion,
                        expected: GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion
                    )
                )
            }

            switch integrityService.validate(decoded.state) {
            case .valid:
                cacheRestored(decoded)
                return .restored(decoded)
            case .invalid(let reason):
                return .dataLoss(reason: .semanticallyInvalid(reason: reason))
            }
        } catch {
            let mapped = mapLoadError(error)
            switch mapped {
            case .decodingFailed, .fileCorrupted:
                return .dataLoss(reason: mapped)
            default:
                return .fallbackDefault(GameSaveFile.default, reason: mapped)
            }
        }
    }

    public func save(_ model: GameSaveFile) async {
        if let pendingModel, pendingModel == model {
            return
        }
        if let lastPersistedModel, lastPersistedModel == model {
            return
        }

        pendingModel = model
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.debounceFloorNanoseconds)
            if Task.isCancelled { return }

            await self.flushPendingWrite()
        }
    }

    public func flush() async {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = nil
        await flushPendingWrite()
    }

    private func flushPendingWrite() async {
        guard let model = pendingModel else { return }

        do {
            try await storage.writeAtomically(model, to: fileURL)
            cacheSaved(model)
        } catch {
            // Keep the pending model so the next explicit flush/save can retry.
            return
        }
    }

    private func cacheRestored(_ model: GameSaveFile) {
        lastPersistedModel = model
        pendingModel = nil
    }

    private func cacheSaved(_ model: GameSaveFile) {
        pendingModel = nil
        lastPersistedModel = model
    }

    private func mapLoadError(_ error: Error) -> PersistenceError {
        switch error {
        case FileStorageError.invalidPayload:
            return .fileCorrupted
        case let FileStorageError.failedToRead(description):
            _ = description
            return .fileCorrupted
        case let FileStorageError.failedToWrite(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory(description):
            return .ioFailed(description: description)
        default:
            return .ioFailed(description: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }
}

    private func apply(_ event: StatsEvent, to model: inout StatsLogFile) {

            stats.gamesPlayed += 1
            stats.lastPlayedAt = startedAt
            if drawMode == .drawOne {

                    stats.bestTimeSeconds = normalizedElapsed
                }
            } else {
                stats.currentStreak = 0
            }

            stats.lastPlayedAt = Date()

            if drawMode == .drawOne {
                drawOne = stats
            } else {

            }

import Foundation

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

        for tableauIndex in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            guard !tableau.isEmpty else { continue }

    }

    public static func isLegalFoundationSetup(_ foundation: [Card], suit: Suit) -> Bool {
        guard let first = foundation.first else { return true }
        guard first.suit == suit else { return false }
        guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: first, destination: []) else {
            return false
        }

        for i in 1..<foundation.count {
            let previous = foundation[i - 1]
            let card = foundation[i]
            guard MoveValidator.canPlaceOnFoundation(card: card, destination: [previous]) else { return false }
        }
        return true
    }

    public static func isAlternatingFaceUpRun(_ run: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard run.count > 1 else { return true }
        guard run.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) else { return false }

        for index in 0..<(run.count - 1) {
            let moving = run[index]
            let top = run[index + 1]
            if !MoveValidator.canPlaceOnTableau(card: top, destinationTop: moving) { return false }
        }
        return true
    }

            interaction = .idle
            return

        if case .dealing = interaction {

            return

                return
            }

            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
            interaction = interaction.transitionToSelectedSource(.waste, cardIndex: index, legalDestinations: destinations)

            if destinations.isEmpty {
                interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: .blocked(reason: "No legal destination for selected card."))

                return

                          self.settings.timerEnabled,
                          let anchor = self.timerAnchor else { return }

                    self.state.elapsedSeconds = self.timerAnchorElapsed + Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func freezeTimerClock() {
        guard state.isTimerRunning, let anchor = timerAnchor else {
            timerTask?.cancel()
            timerTask = nil
            timerAnchor = nil
            return
        }

        state.elapsedSeconds += Date().timeIntervalSince(anchor)
        state.isTimerRunning = false
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = state.elapsedSeconds
    }

    private func stopTimerAndReturnElapsed() -> TimeInterval {
        guard settings.timerEnabled else { return state.elapsedSeconds }
        guard state.isTimerRunning else { return state.elapsedSeconds }

        freezeTimerClock()
        return state.elapsedSeconds
    }

    private func restoreTimer(from restored: GameState) {
        timerTask?.cancel()
        timerTask = nil
        timerAnchor = nil
        timerAnchorElapsed = restored.elapsedSeconds

        guard settings.timerEnabled,
              restored.isTimerRunning,
              restored.terminalState == .active else {
            state.isTimerRunning = false
            return
        }

        state.isTimerRunning = true
        timerAnchor = Date()
        startTimerTask()
    }

    private func persistCurrentSnapshot() {
        Task {
            await persistCurrentSnapshotNow()
        }
    }

    private func persistCurrentSnapshotNow() async {
        let snapshot = GameSaveFile(
            schemaVersion: GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion,
            state: state,
            undoStack: undoStack.entries
        )

        await saveStore.save(snapshot)
    }

    private func persistSettings() {
        Task {
            var file = settings
            file.drawMode = state.drawMode
            await settingsStore.save(file)
        }
    }

    private func scheduleDealCompletionIfNeeded() {
        let token = UUID()
        dealingToken = token

        Task { [weak self] in
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.dealAnimationDuration)
            await MainActor.run {
                guard let self,
                      self.dealingToken == token,
                      case .dealing = self.interaction else {
                    return
                }

                self.interaction = .idle
            }
        }
    }

/// Canonical finite-state interaction contract for the game screen.
/// Game UI must derive all selection/highlight/ambiguity behavior from
/// this type, not from parallel @State booleans.
public enum InteractionState: Equatable, Sendable {
    case idle
    case sourceSelected(PileID, cardIndex: Int, legalDestinations: [PileID])
    case resolvingMove(Move)
    case dealing
    case terminal(TerminalState)

    public static let initial: InteractionState = .idle

    public var selectedSource: PileID? {
        if case .sourceSelected(let source, _, _) = self {
            return source
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var selectedCardIndex: Int? {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, let cardIndex, _) = self {
            return cardIndex
        }
        return nil
    }

    public var legalDestinations: [PileID] {
        if case .sourceSelected(_, _, let legalDestinations) = self {
            return legalDestinations
        }
        return []
    }

    public func transitioned(on attempt: MoveOutcome) -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .sourceSelected(let source, let cardIndex, _):
            switch attempt {
            case .executed(let move):
                return .resolvingMove(move)

            case .ambiguous(source: let source, cardIndex: let cardIndex, destinations: let destinations):
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: destinations)

            case .blocked:
                return .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: [])
            }

        case .resolvingMove:
            if case .executed = attempt {
                return self
            }
            if case .ambiguous = attempt {
                return self
            }
            return self

        default:
            return self
        }
    }

    public func transitionToSelectedSource(
        _ source: PileID,
        cardIndex: Int,
        legalDestinations: [PileID]
    ) -> InteractionState {
        .sourceSelected(source, cardIndex: cardIndex, legalDestinations: legalDestinations)
    }

    public func clearSelection() -> InteractionState {
        switch self {
        case .terminal:
            return self
        default:
            return .idle
        }
    }

import Foundation

public actor GameSaveStore: PersistenceStore {
    public typealias Model = GameSaveFile

    // Floor per DEC-project_plan-005 / DEC-project_plan-006: debounce is fixed
    // at 0.35s to prevent debounce-sensitivity regressions from changing I/O
    // cadence and causing in-flight animation hitches.
    public static let debounceFloorSeconds: TimeInterval = 0.35
    public static let debounceFloorNanoseconds: UInt64 = UInt64(debounceFloorSeconds * 1_000_000_000)

    private let fileURL: URL
    private let storage: FileStorage
    private let integrityService: DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService

    private var pendingWrite: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var pendingModel: GameSaveFile?
    private var lastPersistedModel: GameSaveFile?

    public init(
        fileURL: URL,
        storage: FileStorage = FileStorage(rootURL: URL.standardPersistenceDirectory()),
        integrityService: DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService = .init()
    ) {
        self.fileURL = fileURL
        self.storage = storage
        self.integrityService = integrityService
    }

    deinit {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
    }

    public func load() async -> RestoreOutcome<GameSaveFile> {
        guard storage.fileExists(at: fileURL) else {
            // No save has ever been written here — a fresh install's honest
            // starting state, not a failure to restore anything.
            let fresh = GameSaveFile.default
            cacheRestored(fresh)
            return .restored(fresh)
        }

        do {
            let decoded = try await storage.read(GameSaveFile.self, from: fileURL)

            guard decoded.schemaVersion == GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion else {
                return .fallbackDefault(
                    GameSaveFile.default,
                    reason: .schemaMismatch(
                        found: decoded.schemaVersion,
                        expected: GameSaveFile.currentSchemaVersion
                    )
                )
            }

            switch integrityService.validate(decoded.state) {
            case .valid:
                cacheRestored(decoded)
                return .restored(decoded)
            case .invalid(let reason):
                return .dataLoss(reason: .semanticallyInvalid(reason: reason))
            }
        } catch {
            let mapped = mapLoadError(error)
            switch mapped {
            case .decodingFailed, .fileCorrupted:
                return .dataLoss(reason: mapped)
            default:
                return .fallbackDefault(GameSaveFile.default, reason: mapped)
            }
        }
    }

    public func save(_ model: GameSaveFile) async {
        if let pendingModel, pendingModel == model {
            return
        }
        if let lastPersistedModel, lastPersistedModel == model {
            return
        }

        pendingModel = model
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: Self.debounceFloorNanoseconds)
            if Task.isCancelled { return }

            await self.flushPendingWrite()
        }
    }

    public func flush() async {
        pendingWrite?.cancel()
        pendingWrite = nil
        await flushPendingWrite()
    }

    private func flushPendingWrite() async {
        guard let model = pendingModel else { return }

        do {
            try await storage.writeAtomically(model, to: fileURL)
            cacheSaved(model)
        } catch {
            // Keep the pending model so the next explicit flush/save can retry.
            return
        }
    }

    private func cacheRestored(_ model: GameSaveFile) {
        lastPersistedModel = model
        pendingModel = nil
    }

    private func cacheSaved(_ model: GameSaveFile) {
        pendingModel = nil
        lastPersistedModel = model
    }

    private func mapLoadError(_ error: Error) -> PersistenceError {
        switch error {
        case FileStorageError.invalidPayload:
            return .fileCorrupted
        case let FileStorageError.failedToRead(description):
            _ = description
            return .fileCorrupted
        case let FileStorageError.failedToWrite(description),
             let FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory(description):
            return .ioFailed(description: description)
        default:
            return .ioFailed(description: error.localizedDescription)
        }
    }
}

        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

            }

        for tableauIndex in 0..<min(state.tableau.count, tableauSlots) {
            let tableau = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for candidate in tableau.indices {
                guard tableau[candidate].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: candidate) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }
                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .tableau(tableauIndex), sourceIndex: candidate)

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.move(source: .tableau(tableauIndex), destination: destination, cards: cards))
                }
            }
        }

        return actions
    }

    private static func apply(_ action: SimulationAction, to state: inout GameState) {
        switch action {
        case .drawFromStock:
            guard let card = state.stock.popLast() else { return }
            var drawn = card
            drawn.isFaceUp = true
            state.waste.append(drawn)
        case .move(let source, let destination, let cards):
            guard let firstCard = cards.first else { return }
            switch source {
            case .waste:
                guard let top = state.waste.last, top == firstCard else { return }
                _ = state.waste.popLast()

            case .tableau(let sourceIndex):
                guard let start = state.tableau[sourceIndex].firstIndex(where: { $0.id == firstCard.id }) else { return }
                guard start + cards.count <= state.tableau[sourceIndex].count else { return }
                state.tableau[sourceIndex].removeSubrange(start..<(start + cards.count))

            case .stock, .foundation:
                return
            }

            switch destination {
            case .foundation(let suit):
                if cards.count == 1 {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(cards[0])
                } else {
                    state.foundations[suit, default: []].append(contentsOf: cards)
                }
            case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
                state.tableau[destinationIndex].append(contentsOf: cards)
            case .stock, .waste:
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private static func dealtState(seed: UInt64) -> GameState {
        var rng = SeededRandomNumberGenerator(seed: seed)
        var deck = DeckFactory.shuffledCards(rng: &rng)
        var tableau: [[Card]] = Array(repeating: [], count: tableauSlots)

        var dealIndex = 0
        for round in 0..<tableauSlots {
            for tableaIndex in 0...round {
                tableau[tableaIndex].append(deck[dealIndex])
                dealIndex += 1
            }
        }

        let foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
        for column in 0..<tableauSlots {
            guard !tableau[column].isEmpty else { continue }
            tableau[column][tableau[column].count - 1].isFaceUp = true
        }

        return GameState(
            stock: Array(deck.dropFirst(dealIndex)),
            waste: [],
            foundations: foundations,
            tableau: tableau,
            drawMode: .drawOne
        )
    }
}

import Foundation

enum FileStorageError: Error, Sendable {
    case failedToCreateDirectory(String)
    case failedToRead(String)
    case failedToWrite(String)
    case invalidPayload
}

struct AtomicFileWriter: Sendable {
    typealias PreSwapHook = (URL) throws -> Void

    private let onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook?

    init(onBeforeSwap: PreSwapHook? = nil) {
        self.onBeforeSwap = onBeforeSwap
    }

    func write<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to url: URL) throws {
        let containerURL = url.deletingLastPathComponent()

        do {
            try createDirectoryIfNeeded(at: containerURL)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToCreateDirectory("could not create parent directory for \(url.path): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }

        let data = try encode(value)
        let tempURL = containerURL.appendingPathComponent(".\(url.lastPathComponent).tmp-\(UUID().uuidString)")

        do {
            try data.write(to: tempURL, options: .atomic)
            try onBeforeSwap?(tempURL)
            // replaceItemAt consumes/moves the item at tempURL into place —
            // there is nothing left at tempURL to remove afterward. Removing
            // it here (as a prior version did) throws "no such file" on
            // every successful save and gets caught below as a false write
            // failure, which is exactly the "app lies about the player's
            // own data" bug class this project exists to avoid.
            try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(url, withItemAt: tempURL)
        } catch {
            _ = try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)
            if let error = error as? FileStorageError {
                throw error
            }
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("atomic write failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from url: URL) throws -> T {
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
            throw FileStorageError.invalidPayload
        }

        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(type, from: data)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToRead("decode failed for \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func createDirectoryIfNeeded(at url: URL) throws {
        guard !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else { return }
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    }

    private func encode<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> Data {
        do {
            return try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        } catch {
            throw FileStorageError.failedToWrite("encoding failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }
}

final class FileStorage: Sendable {
    private let rootURL: URL

    init(rootURL: URL) {
        self.rootURL = rootURL
    }

    private func resolvedURL(for fileURL: URL) -> URL {
        fileURL.path.hasPrefix("/") ? fileURL : rootURL.appendingPathComponent(fileURL.lastPathComponent)
    }

    /// Whether a file genuinely exists at `fileURL` yet. Callers use this to
    /// distinguish "nothing has ever been saved here" (the legitimate,
    /// honest starting state on a fresh install — not a failure) from "a
    /// file exists but couldn't be read/decoded" (a real error `read`
    /// should surface). Without this distinction every first launch would
    /// report the identical error as genuine corruption, since
    /// `AtomicFileWriter.read` throws the same `.invalidPayload` for both.
    func fileExists(at fileURL: URL) -> Bool {
        FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: resolvedURL(for: fileURL).path)
    }

    func read<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from fileURL: URL) async throws -> T {
        try AtomicFileWriter().read(type, from: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }

    func writeAtomically<T: Encodable>(_ value: T, to fileURL: URL) async throws {
        try AtomicFileWriter().write(value, to: resolvedURL(for: fileURL))
    }
}

    public func attemptMove(to destination: PileID) -> MoveOutcome {
        guard case .active = state.terminalState else {
            let blocked = MoveOutcome.blocked(reason: "Game is not active.")
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: blocked)
            return blocked
        }

        guard case .sourceSelected(let source, let sourceIndex, _) = interaction else {
            let blocked = MoveOutcome.blocked(reason: "No source selected.")
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: blocked)
            return blocked
        }

        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(
            in: state,
            source: source,
            sourceIndex: sourceIndex,
            destination: destination
        )

        switch outcome {
        case .executed(let move):
            snapshotForUndo()
            apply(move)
            interaction = .resolvingMove(move)

            startTimerIfNeededForAction()
            postMutationRefresh()
            persistCurrentSnapshot()
            haptics.moveAccepted()

        case .ambiguous:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()

        case .blocked:
            interaction = interaction.transitioned(on: outcome)
            haptics.blockedMove()
        }

        return outcome
    }

        } else {

        }

        interaction = interaction.clearSelection()
        haptics.stockDraw()
        postMutationRefresh()

            let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)

                actions.append(.tableauMove(sourcePile: .waste, cardIndex: state.waste.count - 1, destination: destination, cards: [top]))
            }
        }

        for tableauIndex in state.tableau.indices {
            let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
            for index in pile.indices {
                guard pile[index].isFaceUp else { continue }
                let cards = RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: tableauIndex, head: index) ?? []
                if cards.isEmpty { continue }

                let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(
                    in: state,
                    source: .tableau(tableauIndex),
                    sourceIndex: index
                )

                for destination in destinations {
                    actions.append(.tableauMove(

                        destination: destination,
                        cards: cards

                }
            }

            engine.selectCard(pile: source, index: cardIndex)
            let outcome = engine.attemptMove(to: destination)
            switch outcome {

                return move.cards == expectedCards
            case .blocked, .ambiguous:
                return false
            }
        }

            return true
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let pile = state.tableau[index]
            for candidate in pile.indices where pile[candidate].isFaceUp {
                if !RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: candidate).isEmpty {
                    let destinations = MoveValidation.legalDestinations(
                        in: state,

        XCTAssertEqual(allCards.count, 52, "A game state must always hold 52 cards.", file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(allCards.map(\.id)).count, 52, "All 52 cards must be unique.", file: file, line: line)

        for (suit, foundation) in state.foundations {
            XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(foundation.count, 13, "Foundation for \(suit.rawValue) cannot exceed King.", file: file, line: line)
            for card in foundation {
                XCTAssertTrue(card.isFaceUp)
                XCTAssertEqual(card.suit, suit)
            }
            for pair in zip(foundation, foundation.dropFirst()) {
                XCTAssertEqual(pair.0.rank.rawValue + 1, pair.1.rank.rawValue)
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            for index in tableau.indices {
                let current = tableau[index]
                if current.isFaceUp {
                    if index > 0 {
                        let previous = tableau[index - 1]
                        if previous.isFaceUp {
                            XCTAssertEqual(previous.rank.rawValue - 1, current.rank.rawValue)
                            XCTAssertNotEqual(previous.suit.color, current.suit.color)
                        }
                    }
                } else if let previous = tableau[safe: index - 1], previous.isFaceUp {
                    XCTFail("Face-down cards may not appear above a face-up segment.", file: file, line: line)
                }
            }
        }
    }
